-- Funded-account ladder, onboarding and copy-trading regression suite (server only).
-- Studio: StudioDiagnostics:Invoke("FundedTests"). Uses isolated engines; never touches the live exchange.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign
local Default=require(Shared.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(Shared.ProgressionConfig)
local Tests={}
local function deep(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=deep(x) end return r end
local function progression(unlocks)
 local c=deep(Ladder)
 for id,value in pairs(unlocks or {}) do for _,t in ipairs(c.Tiers) do if t.Id==id then t.Unlock=value end end end
 return c
end
local function exchange(unlocks)
 local c=table.clone(Default) c.MaxTradeHistory=100000 c.MaxOrderHistory=100000
 local e=Engine.new(c,55)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,100000,0.99,false) e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,100000,0.99,false)
 return e,Funded.new(e,progression(unlocks),c)
end
local function quote(e,side,price,qty,key)
 local ok,r=e:Submit("maker",{Contract=key or "MES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price}) assert(ok,tostring(r)) return r
end
local function mark(e,price,key) -- one bot-to-bot execution moves the last traded price
 quote(e,-1,price,1,key) local ok,r=e:Submit("taker",{Contract=key or "MES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) assert(ok and r.Filled==1,"mark failed")
end
local function place(e,id,side,qty,key,extra)
 local r={Action="Place",Contract=key or "MES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market"}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do r[k]=v end
 local ok,res=Funded.Perform(e,id,r) assert(ok,tostring(res)) return res,r
end
local function playerAccounts(e,uid)
 local n=0 for id in pairs(e.Accounts) do if id:sub(1,#("player:"..uid..":"))=="player:"..uid..":" then n+=1 end end return n
end
local function tier(view,id) for _,row in ipairs(view.Accounts) do if row.Key==id then return row end end end
local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a-b)<1e-6 end

function Tests.Run()
 local report={} local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,result=pcall(fn) table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and result or tostring(result)})
 end
 test("First join creates nothing; Start creates exactly one $5K starter",function()
  local e,f=exchange()
  assert(f:Join("101")==nil and f:Owner("101")==nil and f:View("101").New,"New player received an implicit account")
  local ok,_,created=f:Start("101") assert(ok and created)
  local again,_,createdAgain=f:Start("101") assert(again and not createdAgain,"Second Start created an account")
  f:Start("101") assert(playerAccounts(e,"101")==1,"Duplicate starter account")
  local a=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
  assert(a.Base==5000 and a.Balance==5000 and a.LossLimit==500 and a.Limit==5 and a.Group=="player:101")
  local v=f:View("101")
  assert(v.Started and v.Active=="F5K" and v.Capital==5000 and v.Earned==0 and v.Tutorial=="Pending" and v.Next.Key=="F10K")
  assert(not v.Copy.Enabled and not v.CopyAvailable,"Copy trading must start off")
  assert(f:Flag("101","TutorialSkipped") and f:View("101").Tutorial=="Skipped")
  return "One starter account; repeated Start is idempotent; tutorial state saved"
 end)
 test("Only net realized profit unlocks; starting balance and open P&L never count",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("7") local id=f:Owner("7")
  quote(e,-1,5825,2) place(e,id,1,2)
  mark(e,5900)
  assert(e:Summary(e.Accounts[id]).Unrealized>700,"Expected a large open gain")
  f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:View("7").Earned==0 and tier(f:View("7"),"F10K").State=="Locked","Unrealized gain unlocked an account")
  assert(f:TakeEvents("7")==nil)
  quote(e,1,5855,2) assert(Funded.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"}))
  assert(near(e.Accounts[id].Realized,300) and near(e.Accounts[id].Balance,5300))
  f:Evaluate("7") local v=f:View("7")
  assert(near(v.Earned,300),"Earned must exclude the $5,000 starting balance")
  assert(tier(v,"F10K").State=="Unlocked" and tier(v,"F25K").State=="Locked" and v.Next.Key=="F25K")
  local events=f:TakeEvents("7")
  assert(events and #events==2 and events[1].Kind=="FirstProfit" and events[2].Kind=="Unlocked" and events[2].Tier=="F10K")
  f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:TakeEvents("7")==nil,"Unlock announced twice")
  local saved=f:Profile("7").Tiers.F10K.UnlockedAt f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:Profile("7").Tiers.F10K.UnlockedAt==saved)
  return "Open +$750 did not unlock; realized +$300 unlocked $10K once"
 end)
 test("Activation needs an unlock, never duplicates, and switching changes the trading account",function()
  local e,f=exchange({F10K=1}) f:Start("8") local id=f:Owner("8")
  assert(not f:Activate("8","F10K"),"Activated a locked tier")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,id,1,1) quote(e,1,5826,1) Funded.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"}) f:Evaluate("8")
  assert(not f:Activate("8","F25K"))
  assert(f:Activate("8","F10K")) local n=playerAccounts(e,"8")
  assert(f:Activate("8","F10K") and playerAccounts(e,"8")==n,"Second activation created another account")
  assert(f:Owner("8")==id,"Activation must not silently switch the traded account")
  assert(f:Select("8","F10K")) local ten=f:Owner("8") assert(ten~=id and e.Accounts[ten].Base==10000 and e.Accounts[ten].LossLimit==800)
  assert(not f:Select("8","F25K") and not f:Select("8","L50000") and f:Owner("8")==ten)
  assert(f:Select("8","F5K") and f:Owner("8")==id)
  local v=f:View("8") assert(v.ActiveCount==2 and v.Capital==15000 and near(v.Earned,5) and v.CopyAvailable)
  return "Locked/duplicate activation rejected; switching F5K <-> F10K works"
 end)
 test("Copy trading: off by default, explicit lead/followers, per-account limits, clear reports",function()
  local e,f=exchange({F10K=1,F25K=2}) f:Start("9") local five=f:Owner("9")
  assert(not f:SetCopy("9",{Enabled=1,Leader="F5K",Followers="F10K"}),"Copy enabled with one account")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,five,1,1) quote(e,1,5827,1) Funded.Perform(e,five,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"}) f:Evaluate("9")
  assert(f:Activate("9","F10K") and f:Activate("9","F25K"))
  local lead,twentyFive=f:Resolve("9","F10K"),f:Resolve("9","F25K")
  assert(f:Plan("9",lead)==nil,"Copy active before being enabled")
  assert(not f:SetCopy("9",{Enabled=1,Leader="F10K",Followers="F50K"}))
  assert(not f:SetCopy("9",{Enabled=1,Leader="F10K",Followers="F10K"}),"Leader cannot follow itself")
  assert(f:SetCopy("9",{Enabled=1,Leader="F10K",Followers="F25K,F5K",Sizing="Same"}))
  local v=f:View("9") assert(v.Copy.Enabled and v.Copy.Followers[1]=="F5K" and tier(v,"F10K").Role=="Lead" and tier(v,"F25K").Role=="Follow")
  quote(e,-1,20485.5,20,"MNQ")
  local plan=f:Plan("9",lead)
  local res,req=place(e,lead,1,3,"MNQ",{StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=80})
  local copies=f:Mirror(plan,req,true,res,f:Context(lead,req))
  assert(copies.Total==2 and copies.Copied==1 and copies.Rejected==1,"Expected one copy and one margin rejection")
  local rejected for _,item in ipairs(copies.Items) do if item.Key=="F5K" then rejected=item end end
  assert(rejected.Status=="Rejected" and rejected.Message:find("margin"),"Rejected copy must carry the engine reason")
  local fp=e.Accounts[twentyFive].Positions.MNQ assert(fp and fp.Quantity==3 and fp.Stop and fp.Target,"Follower copy missing")
  assert(not e.Accounts[five].Positions.MNQ,"Rejected follower received a position")
  -- Linked limit orders are cancelled together.
  local limit,limitReq=place(e,lead,1,1,"MES",{Type="Limit",Price=5800})
  local placed=f:Mirror(plan,limitReq,true,limit,f:Context(lead,limitReq)) assert(placed.Copied==2)
  local linked=0 for _,o in pairs(e.Orders) do if o.Link==limit.Id then linked+=1 end end assert(linked==2)
  local cancelReq={Action="Cancel",OrderId=limit.Id} local context=f:Context(lead,cancelReq)
  local cancelOk,cancelResult=Funded.Perform(e,lead,cancelReq) local cancelled=f:Mirror(plan,cancelReq,cancelOk,cancelResult,context)
  assert(cancelled.Copied==2 and next(e.Accounts[twentyFive].OpenOrders)==nil and next(e.Accounts[five].OpenOrders)==nil)
  -- Protection moves follow the lead price; followers without that position are skipped.
  local stop=e.Accounts[lead].Positions.MNQ.Stop-5
  local amend={Action="AmendProtection",Contract="MNQ",OrderId=e.Accounts[lead].Positions.MNQ.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=stop,ExpectedPrice=e.Accounts[lead].Positions.MNQ.Stop}
  context=f:Context(lead,amend) local amendOk,amendResult=Funded.Perform(e,lead,amend) assert(amendOk,amendResult)
  local amended=f:Mirror(plan,amend,true,amendResult,context)
  assert(amended.Copied==1 and amended.Skipped==1 and e.Accounts[twentyFive].Positions.MNQ.Stop==stop)
  -- Closing the lead closes matching copies only.
  quote(e,1,20480,10,"MNQ")
  local closeReq={Action="Close",Contract="MNQ"} context=f:Context(lead,closeReq)
  local closeOk,closeResult=Funded.Perform(e,lead,closeReq)
  local closed=f:Mirror(plan,closeReq,closeOk,closeResult,context)
  assert(closed.Copied==1 and closed.Skipped==1 and not e.Accounts[twentyFive].Positions.MNQ and not e.Accounts[lead].Positions.MNQ)
  -- A rejected lead copies nothing.
  local badReq={Action="Place",Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=50,Type="Market"}
  local badOk,badResult=Funded.Perform(e,lead,badReq) assert(not badOk)
  local none=f:Mirror(plan,badReq,badOk,badResult,{}) assert(none.Copied==0 and none.Skipped==2)
  return "1 copied + 1 margin rejection reported; linked cancel, SL move and close mirrored"
 end)
 test("Disabling copy keeps every position; accounts then trade independently",function()
  local e,f=exchange({F10K=1}) f:Start("11") local five=f:Owner("11")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,five,1,1) quote(e,1,5827,1) Funded.Perform(e,five,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"}) f:Evaluate("11")
  f:Activate("11","F10K") local ten=f:Resolve("11","F10K")
  assert(f:SetCopy("11",{Enabled=1,Leader="F5K",Followers="F10K"}))
  quote(e,-1,5830,4) local plan=f:Plan("11",five)
  local res,req=place(e,five,1,1,"MES",{StopTicks=40}) f:Mirror(plan,req,true,res,f:Context(five,req))
  local before=table.clone(e.Accounts[ten].Positions.MES)
  local ok,message=f:SetCopy("11",{Enabled=0}) assert(ok and message:find("keeps its positions"))
  local after=e.Accounts[ten].Positions.MES
  assert(after and after.Quantity==before.Quantity and after.Entry==before.Entry and after.Stop==before.Stop,"Disabling copy changed a follower position")
  assert(f:Plan("11",five)==nil)
  quote(e,1,5829,2) Funded.Perform(e,five,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"})
  assert(not e.Accounts[five].Positions.MES and e.Accounts[ten].Positions.MES,"Independent close affected the other account")
  place(e,ten,1,1) assert(e.Accounts[ten].Positions.MES.Quantity==2 and f:Plan("11",ten)==nil)
  return "Follower kept its position and SL; later trades stayed independent"
 end)
 test("One player's accounts never trade against each other",function()
  local e,f=exchange({F10K=1}) f:Start("12") local five=f:Owner("12")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,five,1,1) quote(e,1,5827,1) Funded.Perform(e,five,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"}) f:Evaluate("12")
  f:Activate("12","F10K") local ten=f:Resolve("12","F10K")
  local own=place(e,five,-1,1,"MES",{Type="Limit",Price=5830}) quote(e,-1,5831,1)
  local fill=place(e,ten,1,1)
  assert(fill.Filled==1 and fill.Average==5831 and not e.Orders[own.Id],"Cross-account self-trade was not prevented")
  assert(e.Trades[#e.Trades].Seller=="maker") e:Audit()
  return "Older same-player quote cancelled; fill came from another participant"
 end)
 test("Legacy practice accounts migrate intact and never count toward unlocks",function()
  local e,f=exchange() local legacy="player:42:50000"
  e:AddAccount(legacy,50000,40,0.8,true)
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,legacy,1,1) quote(e,1,5865.75,1) Funded.Perform(e,legacy,{Action="Close",Contract="MES"})
  quote(e,-1,5866,1) place(e,legacy,1,1,"MES",{StopTicks=80})
  local p=f:Join("42")
  assert(p and p.Migrated and #p.Legacy==1 and p.Active=="L50000" and f:Owner("42")==legacy and e.Accounts[legacy].Group=="player:42")
  local v=f:View("42")
  assert(not v.New and not v.Started and v.Earned==0 and v.Capital==0)
  assert(tier(v,"F5K").State=="Start" and v.Next.Key=="F10K","Unstarted starter must offer Start, not a $0 lock")
  assert(near(v.Legacy[1].Balance,50203.75) and v.Legacy[1].Positions==1 and e.Accounts[legacy].Positions.MES.Stop,"Legacy balance/position changed")
  f:Join("42") assert(#f:Profile("42").Legacy==1,"Join duplicated legacy accounts")
  assert(f:Start("42")) f:Evaluate("42")
  v=f:View("42") assert(v.Earned==0 and tier(v,"F10K").State=="Locked" and v.Active=="F5K","Legacy profit counted toward unlocks")
  assert(f:Select("42","L50000") and f:Owner("42")==legacy)
  return "Balance 50,203.75, open position and SL kept; legacy profit excluded"
 end)
 test("Breached accounts restart with fresh capital; realized losses still count",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("5") local id=f:Owner("5")
  quote(e,-1,5825,3) place(e,id,1,3) mark(e,5790)
  assert(not f:Restart("5","F5K"),"Restarted an account in good standing")
  quote(e,1,5790,3) e:AdvanceClock(0.25)
  local a=e.Accounts[id] assert(a.Locked and not a.Positions.MES and near(a.Realized,-525),"Loss limit did not liquidate")
  assert(not select(1,e:Submit(id,{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})),"Breached account accepted an entry")
  assert(f:Restart("5","F5K")) local fresh=f:Owner("5")
  assert(fresh~=id and e.Accounts[fresh].Balance==5000 and not e.Accounts[fresh].Locked and playerAccounts(e,"5")==2)
  local v=f:View("5") assert(near(v.Earned,-525) and near(v.Next.Remaining,825),"Restart erased realized losses")
  assert(not f:Restart("5","F5K"))
  return "Loss -$525 kept in net profit; attempt 2 active"
 end)
 test("Copy sizing: same quantity, proportional by account size, capped",function()
  assert(Funded.Size(3,10000,25000,"Same",20)==3)
  assert(Funded.Size(3,10000,25000,"Proportional",20)==7 and Funded.Size(3,10000,5000,"Proportional",20)==1)
  assert(Funded.Size(1,10000,5000,"Proportional",20)==0 and Funded.Size(15,5000,100000,"Proportional",20)==20)
  return "3→7 at 2.5x, 1→0 skipped, capped at 20"
 end)
 test("Ladder configuration is validated",function()
  local bad=progression() bad.Tiers[2].Unlock=0 assert(not pcall(Funded.Validate,bad))
  bad=progression() bad.Tiers[3].Size=1000 assert(not pcall(Funded.Validate,bad))
  Funded.Validate(progression())
  return "Non-ascending sizes and a second free tier are rejected"
 end)
 if typeof(game)=="Instance" then
  test("Checkpoint v2 keeps profiles; v1 checkpoints restore and migrate",function()
   local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint) local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
   local http=game:GetService("HttpService")
   local e=Engine.new(Default,4242) local population=Participants.new(e) for _=1,300 do population:Step() end
   e:AddAccount("player:88:50000",50000,40,0.8,true)
   local legacyOnly=Checkpoint.Capture(e,population)
   local f=Funded.new(e,progression(),Default) f:Join("88") f:Start("88")
   f:Profile("88").Tiers.F10K={State="Unlocked",UnlockedAt=e.Time,Earned=300,Announced=true}
   f:Activate("88","F10K") f:SetCopy("88",{Enabled=1,Leader="F10K",Followers="F5K",Sizing="Proportional"}) f:Flag("88","TutorialDone")
   local encoded=http:JSONDecode(http:JSONEncode(Checkpoint.Encode(Checkpoint.Capture(e,population))))
   assert(encoded.Version==2)
   local restored=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(encoded),Default)
   local g=Funded.new(restored,progression(),Default)
   local a,b=f:View("88"),g:View("88")
   assert(b.Copy.Enabled and b.Copy.Leader=="F10K" and b.Copy.Sizing=="Proportional" and b.Tutorial=="Done" and b.ActiveCount==2)
   assert(a.Revision==b.Revision and g:Owner("88")==f:Owner("88") and tier(b,"F10K").State=="Active")
   g:Evaluate("88") assert(g:TakeEvents("88")==nil,"Restored unlock announced again")
   legacyOnly.Version=1 legacyOnly.Engine.Profiles=nil
   local old=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(Checkpoint.Encode(legacyOnly)),Default)
   local h=Funded.new(old,progression(),Default)
   local p=h:Join("88") assert(p and p.Migrated and h:Owner("88")=="player:88:50000" and old.Accounts["player:88:50000"].Balance==50000)
   old:Audit() restored:Audit()
   return {V2Bytes=#encoded.Payload,Profiles=1,V1Migrated=true}
  end)
 end
 return report
end
return Tests

local T=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)
return function()
 local checks=0
 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end
 -- A simple linear transform stands in for the chart: 10 px per minute, 4 px per point.
 local function view(left,high) return function(t)return math.floor((t-left)/6+0.5)end,function(p)return math.floor((high-p)*4+0.5)end end
 local X,Y=view(0,120)
 local candles={{Time=600,Open=100,High=110,Low=95,Close=105},{Time=660,Open=105,High=108,Low=101,Close=101}}
 local snap=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(600)+3,Y(110)+4,14)
 check(snap and snap.Field=="High" and snap.Price==110 and snap.Time==600,"Snaps to the nearest OHLC point")
 check(T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(600)+40,Y(110),14)==nil,"No snap outside the radius")
 local close=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(660),Y(101)+2,14) check(close.Price==101,"Snaps to close/low")
 -- Rectangles: stored in time/price, hit-tested in pixels at any zoom.
 local r=T.New("Rect",{Time=600,Price=110},{Time=720,Price=100},"MES","1m")
 check(r.Id and r.Border=="Blue" and r.Opacity==0.15,"Defaults")
 local list={r}
 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Interior,"Interior of an unselected rectangle does not grab")
 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Move","Interior of the selected rectangle moves it")
 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(600),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Move","Edge selects/moves")
 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(720)+3,Y(100)-2,6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner handle")
 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(900),Y(50),6,8,r.Id,1000)==nil,"Empty space pans")
 local X2,Y2=view(300,140) -- panned and rescaled chart: same drawing, new pixels
 check(T.HitTest(list,X2,Y2,X2(720),Y2(100),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Anchors follow the chart after panning")
 local original=T.Copy(r)
 T.Edit(r,original,"Move",nil,{Time=60,Price=2})
 check(r.T1==660 and r.T2==780 and r.P1==112 and r.P2==102,"Move shifts both anchors")
 T.Edit(r,original,"Corner1",{Time=540,Price=115})
 check(r.T1==540 and r.P1==115 and r.T2==720 and r.P2==100,"Corner resize keeps the opposite corner")
 local trend=T.New("Trend",{Time=0,Price=100},{Time=600,Price=110},"MES","1m")
 check(T.HitTest({trend},X,Y,X(300),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==trend,"Trend hit")
 local line=T.New("Line",{Time=0,Price=104},nil,"MES","1m")
 check(T.HitTest({line},X,Y,50,Y(104)+2,6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==line,"Horizontal line hit")
 -- Clipping keeps rotated trend lines inside the plot.
 local ax,ay,bx,by=T.ClipSegment(-50,50,150,50,100,100) check(ax==0 and bx==100 and ay==50,"Clip horizontal")
 check(T.ClipSegment(-10,-10,-5,-5,100,100)==nil,"Clip outside")
 -- Undo/redo restores exact drawing lists.
 local h=T.History(3) local drawings={}
 h:Record(drawings) table.insert(drawings,T.Copy(r))
 local before=T.CopyList(drawings) drawings[1].P1=200 h:Push(before)
 check(h:Undo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==115,"Undo edit")
 check(h:Undo(drawings) and #drawings==0,"Undo create")
 check(not h:Undo(drawings),"Nothing more to undo")
 check(h:Redo(drawings) and #drawings==1 and h:Redo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==200,"Redo")
 h:Record(drawings) check(not h:CanRedo(),"A new edit clears redo")
 for _=1,10 do h:Record(drawings) end check(#h.Past==3,"History is bounded")
 -- Direction uses exact tick counts, so float noise can never flip a candle's colour.
 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.4,Close=2218.4000000001},0.1)==0,"Doji")
 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.3,Close=2218.4},0.1)==1 and T.Direction({Open=5824.75,Close=5824.5},0.25)==-1,"Up/down")
 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Magnet snapping, rectangle/trend/line hit tests, anchoring after pan, move/resize, clipping, undo/redo, direction"}
end

-- Candlestick chart: painting, navigation and drawing tools. Presentation only: it reads candles,
-- quotes and positions from the session and never changes prices or account state, except that a
-- stop/target drag sends the same AmendProtection request the order ticket uses.
local Viewport=require(script.Parent.ChartViewport)
local PaintPool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
local Tools=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local View={} View.__index=View
local MB1,MB2,MB3,TOUCH,MOVE=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,Enum.UserInputType.Touch,Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
local RIGHT,CENTER=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local DRAW={Line=true,Trend=true,Rect=true}
-- Reused native materials: bevels disappear at dense zoom levels without adding image assets.
local CANDLE_LIGHT=ColorSequence.new({
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.35,Color3.fromRGB(232,255,247)),

function View:Changed(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH and self.Touches[ev]then self.Touches[ev]=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)end
 if kind==MOVE then self.LastTouch=false end
 local d=self.Drag
 if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then if kind==TOUCH then self:UpdatePinch()end return end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=MOVE then return end
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 local delta=pos-d.Start
 if not d.Moved and delta.Magnitude<(d.Type==TOUCH and 8 or 4)then return end
 d.Moved=true
 self.Hover=pos
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then Viewport.Pan(d.State,d.View,delta.X,delta.Y,d.Width,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Scale"then Viewport.ScalePrice(d.State,d.View,delta.Y,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local Market=self.Ctx.Market local tick=Market.Contracts[d.Contract].Tick
  d.Price=math.max(tick,Market.Snap(d.Original-delta.Y/d.Height*(d.View.High-d.View.Low),d.Contract))
 elseif self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(pos)
  if d.Kind=="Edit"then
   local pt=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
   local Market=self.Ctx.Market
   Tools.Edit(d.Target,d.Original,d.Part,pt,{Time=pt.Time-d.StartPoint.Time,Price=pt.Snap and pt.Price-d.StartPoint.Price or Market.Snap(pt.Price-d.StartPoint.Price,self.S.Contract)})
  elseif d.Kind=="Place"then self.Placement.B=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then d.Point=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Ended(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH then self.Touches[ev]=nil end
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then
  if kind~=TOUCH then return end
  local remaining,pos=next(self.Touches)
  if remaining and self.Geometry then
   -- Lifting one finger continues as a one-finger pan from where it is.
   local g=self.Geometry
   self.Drag={Kind="Pan",Input=remaining,Type=TOUCH,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true}
  else self:Finish(true)end
  return
 end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=d.Type then return end
 self:Finish(ev.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Cancel)
end
function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil
 local s=self.S local chrome=false
 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then
  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil
   if chosen~=self.Selected then self.Selected=chosen;chrome=true end
  end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then
  if not commit then for k in pairs(d.Target)do d.Target[k]=nil end for k,v in pairs(d.Original)do d.Target[k]=v end
  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end
  if d.SelectChanged then chrome=true end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Place"then
  if not commit or not self.Placement then self.Placement=nil
  elseif d.Moved then self:CommitPlacement();chrome=true
  else self.Placement.Waiting=true end
 elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then
  if commit then
   local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
   local line=Tools.New("Line",d.Point,nil,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
   table.insert(s.Drawings,line);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=line.Id;s.Tool="Pan";chrome=true
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.Original)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.Pending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.Pending==d then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Update not yet confirmed. Showing the last server price.")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message)end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Inspect"then self.Hover=nil
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 self.Ctx.onIdle(chrome)
end
function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))
 if(p.Kind=="Rect"and(w<3 or h<3))or(p.Kind=="Trend"and w+h<4)then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
 table.insert(s.Drawings,d);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=d.Id;s.Tool="Pan"
end
function View:Wheel(ev)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if not g or self.Drag or self.Pending or self:Blocked()then return end
 local x=(ev.Position.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 Viewport.Zoom(g.State,g.View,ev.Position.Z>0 and 0.85 or 1/0.85,x);self.Dirty=true
end
-- Returns true when the key was used by the chart.
function View:KeyBegan(ev)
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then self.Ctrl=true;self.Dirty=true;return false end
 if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
 local ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
 local shift=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
  if self.Drag then self:Finish(false);return true end
  if self.Placement then self.Placement=nil;self.Dirty=true;return true end
  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if self.Selected then self.Selected=nil;self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  return false
 elseif(key==Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)and self:SelectedDrawing()and not self.Drag then
  self:DeleteSelected();return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Z and not self.Drag then if shift then self:Redo()else self:Undo()end return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true
 end
 return false
end
function View:KeyEnded(ev)
 if ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
  self.Ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl);self.Dirty=true
 end
end
-- Cancels the current gesture: an edit restores the drawing, a placement is discarded.
function View:Cancel()
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.Placement=nil self.Dirty=true
end
-- Window focus lost (or the Roblox menu opened): cancel any gesture and clear modifier state.
function View:FocusLost()
 self.Ctrl=false table.clear(self.Touches)
 self:Cancel()
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true self:SetCursor("")
end
function View:Step(dt)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if g and Viewport.Ease(g.State,dt,self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Protection")then self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:OnMarketUpdate()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag
 local message
 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered or held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=pending.Base or not held or held.Id~=pending.Id or held.Triggered or not held[pending.Field]then self.Pending=nil end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 return message
end
function View:OnReply(reply)
 if self.Pending and reply.RequestId==self.Pending.RequestId then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Commands (toolbar, mobile tools sheet, keyboard)
function View:Command(name)
 if name=="Magnet"then self:ToggleMagnet()
 elseif name=="Undo"then self:Undo()
 elseif name=="Redo"then self:Redo()
 elseif name=="Clear"then self:Clear()
 else self:SetTool(name)end
end
function View:SetTool(name)
 self.S.Tool=name self.Placement=nil
 if DRAW[name]then self.Selected=nil end
 self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ToggleMagnet() self.S.Magnet=not self.S.Magnet self.Ctx.refresh() end
function View:CancelPlacement() self.Placement=nil self.Dirty=true end
function View:Undo()
 if self.History:Undo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:Redo()
 if self.History:Redo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:DeleteSelected()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(self.S.Drawings)
 for i,x in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do if x==d then table.remove(self.S.Drawings,i)break end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:Clear()
 local s=self.S local current=self:Current()
 if #current==0 then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 for i=#s.Drawings,1,-1 do local d=s.Drawings[i] if d.Contract==s.Contract and d.Timeframe==s.Timeframe then table.remove(s.Drawings,i)end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Placement=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:SetStyle(field,value)
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d or d[field]==value then return end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d[field]=value self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleFill()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Colors local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if v==d.Fill then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Fill=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleOpacity()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Opacities local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if math.abs(v-(d.Opacity or 0.15))<0.001 then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Opacity=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ActiveState() local g=self.Geometry return g and g.State,g end
function View:ResetView() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.Reset(state);self.Base=nil;self.Dirty=true end end
function View:AutoFit() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.AutoFit(state);self.Dirty=true end end
function View:GoLive()
 local state=self:ActiveState()
 if state and not self.Drag then Viewport.GoLive(state,self.Ctx.Session.Prices[self.S.Contract]);self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:Destroy() self:SetCursor("") end
return View

UIFeedback.Source:
-- Interaction feedback for the Get Funded! GUI: hover/press/release tweens, selection pops, popup
-- transitions and a small palette of UI sounds. Presentation only; it never changes trading state.
-- The GUI is rebuilt on refresh, so per-control state (hover, last press, selection) is remembered by
-- the control's path. A rebuilt control continues its animation instead of snapping or replaying it.
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local FX={} FX.__index=FX

-- Official Roblox GUI sounds (public, Roblox-owned). Volumes are relative to the master volume.
FX.Sounds={
 Click={Id=17208396156,Volume=.30,Gap=.045,Speed=1.05},  -- Roblox GUI - Select
 Tick={Id=17208396156,Volume=.16,Gap=.04,Speed=1.25},    -- steppers: lighter and shorter
 Select={Id=17208204604,Volume=.24,Gap=.06},             -- Roblox GUI - Bubble: tabs, segments, toggles
 Open={Id=17208405682,Volume=.18,Gap=.09},               -- Roblox GUI - Swipe: popups and sheets
 Send={Id=17208399163,Volume=.26,Gap=.1},                -- Roblox GUI - Send: order submitted (not confirmed)
 Success={Id=17208380755,Volume=.34,Gap=.12},            -- Roblox GUI - Purchase: server-confirmed action
 Milestone={Id=17208361335,Volume=.36,Gap=.4},           -- Roblox GUI - Notification High: unlocks
 Error={Id=17208353912,Volume=.30,Gap=.22},              -- Roblox GUI - Negative: rejected or invalid
}
FX.Levels={Low=.35,Medium=.65,High=1}
local QUICK=TweenInfo.new(.07,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local HOVER=TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SETTLE=TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local BOUNCE=TweenInfo.new(.26,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local POP=TweenInfo.new(.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

function FX.new(root,options)
 options=options or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Root=root,Memory={},MemoryCount=0,Loops={},Last={},LastAny=0,Tweens=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
  Enabled=options.Sound~=false,Level=options.Level or "Medium",Preview=options.Preview==true,Alive=true,Played={}},FX)
 -- Edit previews are saved into the place; they never create sounds or effect layers.
 if not self.Preview then self:_sounds() end
 return self
end
function FX:_sounds()
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder") folder.Name="GetFundedUISounds"
 local group=Instance.new("SoundGroup") group.Name="GetFundedUI" group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] or .65 group.Parent=SoundService
 self.Group=group self.Folder=folder self.Instances={}
 for name,spec in pairs(FX.Sounds)do
  local s=Instance.new("Sound") s.Name=name s.SoundId="rbxassetid://"..spec.Id s.Volume=spec.Volume s.PlaybackSpeed=spec.Speed or 1
  s.SoundGroup=group s.Parent=folder self.Instances[name]=s
 end
 folder.Parent=SoundService
end
function FX:SetSound(enabled,level)
 if enabled~=nil then self.Enabled=enabled==true end
 if level and FX.Levels[level]then self.Level=level end
 if self.Group then self.Group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] end
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundEnabled",self.Enabled);self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundLevel",self.Level)end
end
-- Plays one UI sound, rate limited per sound and overall so rapid input never becomes noise.
function FX:Play(name)
 local spec=FX.Sounds[name] local s=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]
 self.Played[name]=(self.Played[name] or 0)+1
 if not spec or not s or not self.Enabled then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(self.Last[name] or 0)<spec.Gap or now-self.LastAny<.03 then return false end
 self.Last[name]=now self.LastAny=now
 s.TimePosition=0 s:Play()
 -- Studio diagnostics: how often each sound actually played (after rate limiting).
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name,(self.Root:GetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name)or 0)+1)end
 return true
end

-- An accent only plays when nothing else just played (a popup opened by a click keeps the click).
function FX:Accent(name)
 if os.clock()-self.LastAny<.12 then return false end
 return self:Play(name)
end
-- Per-path memory survives GUI rebuilds.
function FX:Mem(key)
 local m=self.Memory[key]
 if not m then
  if self.MemoryCount>1500 then table.clear(self.Memory) self.MemoryCount=0 end
  m={} self.Memory[key]=m self.MemoryCount+=1
 end
 return m
end
function FX:Tween(o,info,props)
 local old=self.Tweens[o] if old then old:Cancel() end
 local t=TweenService:Create(o,info,props) self.Tweens[o]=t t:Play() return t
end
local function scaleOf(o,name)
 local s=o:FindFirstChild(name or "PressScale")
 if not s then s=Instance.new("UIScale") s.Name=name or "PressScale" s.Parent=o end
 return s
end
FX.ScaleOf=scaleOf
-- UIScale scales around the anchor point; centre it so controls grow and shrink in place.
local function centre(o)
 if o.AnchorPoint~=Vector2.zero or not o.Parent then return end
 local size,pos=o.Size,o.Position
 o.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 o.Position=pos+UDim2.new(size.X.Scale/2,size.X.Offset/2,size.Y.Scale/2,size.Y.Offset/2)
end
FX.Centre=centre
local function inside(o)
 if not UIS.MouseEnabled or not o.Parent then return false end
 local m=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
 local gui=o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
 if not(gui and gui.IgnoreGuiInset)then m-=GuiService:GetGuiInset()end
 local p,s=o.AbsolutePosition,o.AbsoluteSize
 return m.X>=p.X and m.X<=p.X+s.X and m.Y>=p.Y and m.Y<=p.Y+s.Y
end
local function sheen(o)
 local f=o:FindFirstChild("HoverSheen")
 if not f then
  f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Name="HoverSheen" f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
  f.BackgroundTransparency=1 f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.ZIndex=o.ZIndex f.Active=false
  local corner=o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
  if corner then local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=corner.CornerRadius c.Parent=f end
  f.Parent=o
 end
 return f
end

-- Hover, press and release feedback for one button. Options: Lift, Press, Sheen (0..1), Quiet.
function FX:Bind(b,opts)
 if self.Preview then return end
 opts=opts or {}
 local lift,press=opts.Lift or 1.035,opts.Press or .94
 local glow=opts.Sheen or .9
 local key
 local rest
 local function k() key=key or b:GetFullName() return key end
 local function enabled() return b.Active~=false and not b:GetAttribute("Disabled") end
 local function darken(on)
  if b.BackgroundTransparency>=1 then return end
  rest=rest or b:GetAttribute("RestingColor") or b.BackgroundColor3
  self:Tween(b,on and QUICK or SETTLE,{BackgroundColor3=on and rest:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.16) or rest})
 end
 local function state(name,instant)
  if not b.Parent then return end
  local sc=scaleOf(b)
  local target=name=="Down" and press or name=="Hover" and lift or 1
  if instant then sc.Scale=target else
   self:Tween(sc,name=="Down" and QUICK or name=="Release" and BOUNCE or name=="Hover" and HOVER or SETTLE,{Scale=name=="Release" and lift or target})
  end
  if b.BackgroundTransparency<1 or opts.Sheen then
   local f=sheen(b)
   local t=(name=="Hover" or name=="Release") and glow or name=="Down" and math.min(1,glow+.05) or 1
   if instant then f.BackgroundTransparency=t else self:Tween(f,HOVER,{BackgroundTransparency=t})end
  end
 end
 b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=true
  if enabled() then state("Hover") end
 end)
 b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=false
  state("Leave") darken(false)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
  if not enabled() then if not opts.Quiet then self:Shake(b) end return end
  self:Mem(k()).PressedAt=os.clock()
  state("Down") darken(true)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
  darken(false)
  if enabled() then state(UIS.MouseEnabled and inside(b) and "Release" or "Leave") end
 end)
 -- After the whole render: centre, then restore hover or finish a press that caused the rebuild.
 task.defer(function()
  if not b.Parent or not self.Alive then return end
  centre(b)
  local m=self.Memory[k()]
  if not m then return end
  local recent=m.PressedAt and os.clock()-m.PressedAt<.32
  local hovering=m.Hover and inside(b)
  if not hovering then m.Hover=false end
  if recent and enabled() then
   scaleOf(b).Scale=press state(hovering and "Release" or "Leave")
  elseif hovering and enabled() then state("Hover",true) end
 end)
end
-- Debounce: returns true when this activation should be ignored (repeat within `gap`, or disabled).
function FX:Guard(b,gap)
 if b:GetAttribute("Disabled") then return true end
 local m=self:Mem(b:GetFullName()) local now=os.clock()
 if m.ActivatedAt and now-m.ActivatedAt<(gap or .12) then return true end
 m.ActivatedAt=now m.PressedAt=m.PressedAt or now
 return false
end
-- Pops a control when it becomes selected (not when it is merely rebuilt while selected).
function FX:Selected(o,selected)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Selected m.Selected=selected
 if selected and was==false then
  task.defer(function()
   if not o.Parent then return end
   centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end)
 end
end
-- A short bump when a displayed value changes (steppers). Frequent market readouts do not use this.
function FX:Bump(o,value)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Value m.Value=value
 if was~=nil and was~=value then
  local sc=scaleOf(o,"BumpScale") sc.Scale=1.16 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
 end
end
function FX:Shake(o)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 if m.Shaking then return end m.Shaking=true
 local base=o.Position
 local offsets={-7,6,-4,3,0}
 task.spawn(function()
  for _,dx in ipairs(offsets)do
   if not o.Parent then break end
   local t=TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(.035,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),{Position=base+UDim2.fromOffset(dx,0)})
   t:Play() t.Completed:Wait()
  end
  if o.Parent then o.Position=base end
  m.Shaking=false
 end)
end
-- Popup entrance: scale from 90% with a light overshoot and fade the backdrop in.
function FX:Open(dialog,backdrop,fromBottom)
 if self.Preview then return end
 if dialog and dialog.Parent then
  if fromBottom then
   local target=dialog.Position dialog.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.min(80,dialog.AbsoluteSize.Y*.25))
   self:Tween(dialog,TweenInfo.new(.24,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target})
  else
   centre(dialog) local sc=scaleOf(dialog,"PopScale") sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end
 end
 if backdrop and backdrop.Parent then
  local t=backdrop.BackgroundTransparency backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1
  self:Tween(backdrop,TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{BackgroundTransparency=t})
 end
end
-- Popup exit: the closed popup is moved out of the canvas (which is about to be rebuilt) into a
-- non-interactive CanvasGroup that fades and shrinks, then is destroyed.
function FX:Ghost(items)
 if self.Preview or not self.Root or #items==0 then for _,o in ipairs(items)do o:Destroy()end return end
 local ghost=Instance.new("CanvasGroup") ghost.Name="PopupGhost" ghost.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) ghost.BackgroundTransparency=1
 ghost.BorderSizePixel=0 ghost.ZIndex=6 pcall(function()ghost.Interactable=false end)
 ghost.Parent=self.Root
 for _,o in ipairs(items)do
  for _,d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiButton")or d:IsA("TextBox")then d.Active=false pcall(function()d.Interactable=false end)end end
  o.Parent=ghost
  if o.Name~="OverlayBackdrop"and o.Name~="SheetBackdrop"then
   centre(o) self:Tween(scaleOf(o,"PopScale"),TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Scale=.94})
  end
 end
 local t=TweenService:Create(ghost,TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{GroupTransparency=1})
 t.Completed:Connect(function()ghost:Destroy()end) t:Play()
 task.delay(.5,function()if ghost.Parent then ghost:Destroy()end end)
end
-- Effects that must outlive a rebuild (success rings) live on a layer above the canvas.
function FX:Layer()
 if self.Preview or not self.Root then return nil end
 local layer=self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer")
 if not layer then
  layer=Instance.new("Frame") layer.Name="EffectsLayer" layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) layer.BackgroundTransparency=1
  layer.BorderSizePixel=0 layer.ZIndex=7 layer.Active=false layer.Parent=self.Root
 end
 return layer
end
-- Expanding glow ring around a control's on-screen rectangle.
function FX:Ring(o,color,radius)
 local layer=self:Layer() if not layer or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 local p=o.AbsolutePosition-self.Root.AbsolutePosition local s=o.AbsoluteSize
 local ring=Instance.new("Frame") ring.Name="SuccessRing" ring.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 ring.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2) ring.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X,s.Y)
 ring.BackgroundColor3=color ring.BackgroundTransparency=.7 ring.BorderSizePixel=0 ring.ZIndex=8
 local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 12) c.Parent=ring
 local st=Instance.new("UIStroke") st.Color=color st.Thickness=3 st.Parent=ring
 ring.Parent=layer
 local info=TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
 TweenService:Create(ring,info,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X+26,s.Y+26),BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
 local fade=TweenService:Create(st,info,{Transparency=1}) fade.Completed:Connect(function()ring:Destroy()end) fade:Play()
end
function FX:Pulse(o)

 centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=1.07 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
end
-- Looping decorations (loading dots, coach highlight) are stopped before each rebuild.
function FX:Loop(tween) table.insert(self.Loops,tween) tween:Play() return tween end
function FX:StopLoops() for _,t in ipairs(self.Loops)do t:Cancel()end table.clear(self.Loops) end
function FX:Destroy()
 self.Alive=false self:StopLoops()
 for o,t in pairs(self.Tweens)do t:Cancel()end
 if self.Folder then self.Folder:Destroy() end
 if self.Group then self.Group:Destroy() end
 local layer=self.Root and self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer") if layer then layer:Destroy() end
end
return FX

-- Presentation-only chart navigation. Never modifies prices, candles or account state.
-- Time is horizontal (seconds), price is vertical. All inputs are screen deltas in pixels.
local Viewport={}
Viewport.Seconds={["1m"]=60,["5m"]=300,["15m"]=900,["1h"]=3600,["1D"]=86400}
Viewport.MinBars=10          -- deepest zoom-in
Viewport.MaxBars=1000        -- absolute zoom-out ceiling (render budget)
Viewport.PixelsPerBar=2      -- never draw more than one candle per 2 px of plot width
Viewport.RightMargin=3       -- empty bars to the right of the live candle
Viewport.EaseSeconds=0.07    -- auto-fit price-scale smoothing
Viewport.DefaultBars={Desktop=72,Mobile=36}

-- Practical zoom range: limited by the available history and by how many candles the plot can draw.
function Viewport.Limits(count,width)
 local render=math.clamp(math.floor((width or 800)/Viewport.PixelsPerBar),Viewport.MinBars+10,Viewport.MaxBars)
 local data=math.max(40,math.ceil(count*1.15)+Viewport.RightMargin+2)
 return Viewport.MinBars,math.max(Viewport.MinBars+2,math.min(render,data))
end
-- First index whose candle time is >= time (binary search; candles are time ordered).
local function lowerBound(candles,time)
 local lo,hi=1,#candles+1
 while lo<hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if candles[mid].Time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end end
 return lo
end
Viewport.LowerBound=lowerBound

function Viewport.Resolve(state,candles,timeframe,tick,mobile,levels,width)
 if #candles==0 then return nil end
 local interval=Viewport.Seconds[timeframe]
 local minBars,maxBars=Viewport.Limits(#candles,width)
 state.Bars=math.clamp(state.Bars or (mobile and Viewport.DefaultBars.Mobile or Viewport.DefaultBars.Desktop),minBars,maxBars)
 state.Interval=interval
 local latest,earliest=candles[#candles].Time,candles[1].Time
 if state.Right==nil then state.Right=latest+Viewport.RightMargin*interval state.Follow=true end
 -- Following: new candles scroll the view by exactly the time they add. Detached: the view never moves.
 if state.Follow and state.Latest and latest~=state.Latest then state.Right+=latest-state.Latest end
 state.Latest=latest
 local maximum=latest+state.Bars*0.8*interval
 local minimum=math.min(earliest+math.min(6,state.Bars*0.5)*interval,maximum)
 state.Right=math.clamp(state.Right,minimum,maximum)
 local right=state.Right local left=right-state.Bars*interval
 -- One extra candle each side so partially visible bodies are drawn and clipped, not popped.
 local first=lowerBound(candles,left-interval) local last=lowerBound(candles,right+interval)-1
 local visible=table.move(candles,first,math.max(first-1,last),1,{})
 local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(visible)do
  if c.Time>=left-interval*0.5 and c.Time<=right+interval*0.5 then low=math.min(low,c.Low) high=math.max(high,c.High) end
 end
 if low==math.huge then local c=candles[math.clamp(first,1,#candles)] low=c.Low high=c.High end
 -- While following, keep the live price and the open position's levels in view.
 if state.Follow then for _,price in ipairs(levels or {})do low=math.min(low,price) high=math.max(high,price) end end
 local padding=math.max(tick*2,(high-low)*0.08)
 local targetLow,targetHigh=low-padding,high+padding
 state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh=targetLow,targetHigh
 local auto=state.AutoY~=false
 local lo,hi
 if auto then
  if not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=targetLow,targetHigh end
  lo,hi=state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh
 else lo,hi=state.Low,state.High end
 if hi-lo<tick then local mid=(lo+hi)/2 lo,hi=mid-tick/2,mid+tick/2 end
 return {Left=left,Right=right,Low=lo,High=hi,Bars=state.Bars,Interval=interval,Data=visible,First=first,
  Earliest=earliest,Latest=latest,Minimum=minimum,Maximum=maximum,MinBars=minBars,MaxBars=maxBars,Tick=tick,
  Follow=state.Follow==true,AutoY=auto,TargetLow=targetLow,TargetHigh=targetHigh,
  Live=state.Follow==true and auto}
end
-- Eases the displayed auto-fit range toward its target. Returns true while still moving.
function Viewport.Ease(state,dt,snap)
 if state.AutoY==false or not state.TargetLow then return false end
 if snap or not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false end
 local range=math.max(1e-9,state.TargetHigh-state.TargetLow)
 local dl,dh=state.TargetLow-state.ShowLow,state.TargetHigh-state.ShowHigh
 if math.abs(dl)<range*0.0005 and math.abs(dh)<range*0.0005 then
  state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false
 end
 local k=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/Viewport.EaseSeconds)
 state.ShowLow+=dl*k state.ShowHigh+=dh*k
 return true
end
function Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction) return view.Left+(view.Right-view.Left)*fraction end
function Viewport.PriceAt(view,fraction) return view.High-(view.High-view.Low)*fraction end
function Viewport.X(view,time,width) return (time-view.Left)/(view.Right-view.Left)*width end
function Viewport.Y(view,price,height) return (view.High-price)/(view.High-view.Low)*height end
local function refollow(state)
 if state.Latest and state.Interval then state.Follow=state.Right>=state.Latest+state.Interval*0.5 end
end
-- Manual price scale: fix the current range so later changes are explicit.
local function manual(state,view)
 if state.AutoY~=false then state.AutoY=false state.Low,state.High=view.Low,view.High end
end
function Viewport.Pan(state,start,dx,dy,width,height)
 state.Right=math.clamp(start.Right-dx/math.max(1,width)*(start.Right-start.Left),math.min(start.Minimum,start.Maximum),start.Maximum)
 -- Auto-fit keeps the price axis fitted to the candles; a manual scale pans vertically with the pointer.
 if not start.AutoY then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
function Viewport.Zoom(state,view,factor,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 local bars=math.clamp(view.Bars*factor,view.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,view.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction)
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-fraction)*bars*view.Interval
 refollow(state)
end
-- Two-finger gesture: the time under the starting midpoint stays under the current midpoint.
function Viewport.Pinch(state,start,fromFraction,toFraction,ratio,dy,height)
 local bars=math.clamp(start.Bars*ratio,start.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,start.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(start,math.clamp(fromFraction,0,1))
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-toFraction)*bars*start.Interval
 if not start.AutoY and dy then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Y-axis drag: down expands the visible price range (candles shorter), up compresses it (taller).
function Viewport.ScalePrice(state,start,dy,height)
 local factor=math.exp(math.clamp(dy,-2000,2000)/math.max(120,height)*1.6)
 local mid=(start.Low+start.High)/2
 local half=math.clamp((start.High-start.Low)/2*factor,(start.Tick or 0.01)*2,math.max(1,math.abs(mid))*2)
 state.AutoY=false state.Low=mid-half state.High=mid+half
end
function Viewport.AutoFit(state)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.Low,state.High end
 state.AutoY=true state.Low=nil state.High=nil
end
-- Follow the live candle again at the current zoom. A manual scale is re-centred on the live price.
function Viewport.GoLive(state,price)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low and price then
  local half=(state.High-state.Low)/2 state.Low=price-half state.High=price+half
 end
 state.Right=nil state.Follow=true
end
function Viewport.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state)
end
Viewport.Manual=manual
local niceSteps={1,2,2.5,5}
-- Round-number price grid; every label is a multiple of the contract tick.
function Viewport.PriceTicks(low,high,tick,count)
 local range=math.max(high-low,tick) local raw=range/math.max(1,count)
 local magnitude=10^math.floor(math.log10(raw)) local step
 for _,m in ipairs(niceSteps)do if m*magnitude>=raw then step=m*magnitude break end end
 step=step or 10*magnitude
 step=math.max(tick,math.ceil(step/tick-1e-9)*tick)
 local ticks={} local p=math.ceil(low/step-1e-9)*step
 while p<=high+1e-9 and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,p) p+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
local timeSteps={60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,10800,14400,21600,43200,86400,172800,432000,864000,2592000}
function Viewport.TimeTicks(left,right,interval,count)
 local raw=(right-left)/math.max(1,count) local step=timeSteps[#timeSteps]
 for _,s in ipairs(timeSteps)do if s>=interval and s>=raw then step=s break end end
 local ticks={} local t=math.ceil(left/step)*step
 while t<=right and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,t) t+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
return Viewport

ChartPaintPool.Source:
-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z)
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),1)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

MarketClient.Source:
-- Read-only client view. All orders and balances are owned by MarketServer.
local root=script.Parent
local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)
local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)
local Market={Contracts=Config.Contracts,ContractOrder=Config.ContractOrder,Progression=Progression}
function Market.Number(value)
 local raw=string.format("%.2f",math.abs(value or 0)) local whole,decimal=raw:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
 return ((value or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","").."."..decimal
end
function Market.Money(value) return "$"..Market.Number(value) end
function Market.Signed(value) return (value<0 and "−" or "+")..Market.Money(math.abs(value)) end
function Market.Snap(value,key) return math.round(value/Config.Contracts[key].Tick)*Config.Contracts[key].Tick end
local Session={} Session.__index=Session
function Market.New(base,preview,previewData)
 base=base or Progression.Tiers[1].Size
 local self=setmetatable({Base=base,Prices={},Quotes={},Positions={},Orders={},History={},Fills={},Cache={},
  Time=0,Regime="Connecting",Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed,Ready=false,CanTrade=false,NextId=0,Pending={},Contract="MES",Timeframe="1m",
  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Replies=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Events=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Preview=preview},Session)
 self.SummaryData={Balance=base,Equity=base,Unrealized=0,Session=0,Allowance=Progression.Tiers[1].LossLimit,Count=0,Margin=0}
 for _,key in ipairs(Market.ContractOrder) do self.Prices[key]=Market.Contracts[key].Last end
 if preview then
  self.Regime="Edit preview"
  if previewData then
   -- An offline snapshot generated by the real exchange, used only to author Studio's saved GUI.
   self.Quotes=previewData.Quotes self.Cache=previewData.CandlesBySeries
   self.Time=previewData.Time self.Step=previewData.Step
   for key,quote in pairs(self.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end
  end
  return self
 end
 self.Remote=root:WaitForChild("OrderRequest",60)
 local update=root:WaitForChild("MarketUpdate",60)
 if not self.Remote or not update then self.Regime="Exchange unavailable" return self end
 self.Connection=update.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
  self.CanTrade=packet.CanTrade==true self.ConnectionStatus=packet.ConnectionStatus self.PersistenceMode=packet.PersistenceMode
  -- Funded portfolio (ladder, balances, copy settings) arrives on change and about once per second.
  if packet.Portfolio then self.Portfolio=packet.Portfolio end
  if packet.StatusOnly then
   if packet.NoAccount then
    -- No trading account yet (first join): clear any previous account view.
    self.Ready=false self.AccountKey=nil self.Positions={} self.Orders={} self.History={} self.Fills={}
   end
   for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {})do self.Pending[reply.RequestId]=nil self.Replies:Fire(reply)end
   for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self.Events:Fire(event)end
   self.Changed:Fire()return
  end
  self.Ready=true self.Base=packet.Base self.AccountKey=packet.AccountKey self.Positions=packet.Positions
  self.Orders=packet.Orders or self.Orders self.History=packet.History or self.History self.Fills=packet.Fills or self.Fills
  self.SummaryData=packet.Summary self.Quotes=packet.Quotes self.Time=packet.Time
  self.Regime=packet.Regime self.News=packet.News self.Speed=packet.Speed self.Step=packet.Step
  for key,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end
  local cacheKey=packet.Contract..":"..packet.Timeframe
  -- A subscription can be dropped by the server's request rate limit (fast contract/timeframe
  -- switching). If the server is still streaming another series, ask again instead of waiting forever.
  if(packet.Contract~=self.Contract or packet.Timeframe~=self.Timeframe)and os.clock()-(self.SubscribedAt or 0)>1.5 then
   self:Subscribe(self.Contract,self.Timeframe)
  end
  if packet.Full then self.Cache[cacheKey]=packet.Candles else
   local data=self.Cache[cacheKey] or {} self.Cache[cacheKey]=data
   for _,candle in ipairs(packet.Candles) do
    local found=false
    for i=math.max(1,#data-2),#data do if data[i].Time==candle.Time then data[i]=candle found=true break end end
    if not found then table.insert(data,candle) end
   end
   while #data>Config.MaxCandles do table.remove(data,1) end
  end
  for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {}) do self.Pending[reply.RequestId]=nil self.Replies:Fire(reply) end
  for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self.Events:Fire(event)end
  self.Changed:Fire()
 end)
 self:Subscribe("MES","1m")
 local start=os.clock() while not self.Ready and not self.ConnectionStatus and os.clock()-start<45 do task.wait(0.1) end
 return self
end
function Session:Send(action,request)
 if self.Preview then return false,"Edit preview only. Press Play to trade in the simulated market." end
 if not self.Remote then return false,"Exchange is connecting." end
 if action~="Subscribe"and not self.CanTrade then return false,self.ConnectionStatus or "Waiting for the simulated exchange."end
 self.NextId+=1 request=request or {} request.Id=self.NextId request.Action=action
 self.Pending[self.NextId]=os.clock() self.Remote:FireServer(request)
 return true,"Order sent to simulated exchange.","Orders",self.NextId
end
function Session:Subscribe(key,tf)
 self.Contract=key self.Timeframe=tf self.SubscribedAt=os.clock() self:Send("Subscribe",{Contract=key,Timeframe=tf})
end
function Session:Candles(key,tf) return self.Cache[key..":"..tf] or {} end
function Session:Pnl(p) return p.Unrealized or 0 end
function Session:Summary() return self.SummaryData end
function Session:Working() return self.Orders end
function Session:Cancel(id,protection) return self:Send("Cancel",{OrderId=id,Protection=protection}) end
function Session:AmendProtection(key,id,field,price,expectedPrice)
 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice})
end
function Session:Close(key) return self:Send("Close",{Contract=key}) end
-- Funded-account lifecycle. The server validates every request against the saved profile.
function Session:Account(key) return self:Send("Account",{Key=key}) end
function Session:Start() return self:Send("Start",{}) end
function Session:Activate(tier) return self:Send("Activate",{Tier=tier}) end
function Session:Restart(tier) return self:Send("Restart",{Tier=tier}) end
function Session:Flag(stage) return self:Send("Flag",{Stage=stage}) end
function Session:Copy(enabled,leader,followers,sizing)
 return self:Send("Copy",{Enabled=enabled and 1 or 0,Leader=leader,Followers=table.concat(followers or {},","),Sizing=sizing})
end
function Session:Place(key,direction,quantity,orderType,limit,stopTicks,targetTicks)
 if not self.Ready then return false,"Waiting for simulated exchange." end
 return self:Send("Place",{Contract=key,Direction=direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=orderType,Price=orderType=="Limit" and limit or nil,
  StopTicks=stopTicks,TargetTicks=targetTicks})
end
function Session:Destroy()
 if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect() end self.Changed:Destroy() self.Replies:Destroy() self.Events:Destroy()
end
return Market
