local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService=game:GetService("TeleportService")
local root=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MarketReign")
local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)
local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)
local World=require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
Funded.Validate(Progression) -- A malformed ladder must stop the server, not corrupt saved profiles.
local function remote(name)
 local old=root:FindFirstChild(name) if old then old:Destroy() end
 local r=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") r.Name=name r.Parent=root return r
end
local requestRemote=remote("OrderRequest") local updateRemote=remote("MarketUpdate")
local world=World.new(Config)
local market,population,funded local epoch=-1
root:SetAttribute("SessionSeed",nil) root:SetAttribute("Ready",false)
local clients={} local queue={} local sequence=0 local actionLog={}
-- The trading account comes from the player's saved funded profile. New players have no account until
-- they press Start, so joining never creates a starter (or duplicate) account.
local function resolve(player,state)
 if not funded then return end
 funded:Join(state.Uid) funded:Evaluate(state.Uid)
 state.Owner=funded:Owner(state.Uid) state.Full=true state.PortfolioRevision=nil
end
local function add(player)
 if clients[player] then return end
 clients[player]={Uid=Funded.Key(player.UserId),Contract="MES",Timeframe="1m",Full=true,Tokens=20,TokenTime=os.clock(),
  Seen={},SeenOrder={},Replies={},Subscribed=false,PortfolioAt=0}
 resolve(player,clients[player])
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(add) for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do add(p) end
-- Portfolio view: on change, on full refresh and once per second for dashboard balances.
local function attachPortfolio(state,packet)
 if not funded then return end
 packet.Events=funded:TakeEvents(state.Uid)
 local profile=funded:Profile(state.Uid)
 local revision=profile and profile.Revision or 0 local now=os.clock()
 if state.Full or state.PortfolioRevision~=revision or now-state.PortfolioAt>=1 then
  packet.Portfolio=funded:View(state.Uid) state.PortfolioRevision=revision state.PortfolioAt=now
 end
end
local function emit(player,state)
 local unavailable=not market or world.Mode=="Unavailable" or world.Mode=="Following" or world.Mode=="Loading"
 if unavailable or not state.Owner or not market.Accounts[state.Owner] then
  -- No trading account yet (first join) or the exchange is not ready: send status and portfolio only.
  local packet={StatusOnly=true,CanTrade=not unavailable and world:CanRun(),ConnectionStatus=world:Label(),Replies=state.Replies,NoAccount=not unavailable or nil}
  if not unavailable then attachPortfolio(state,packet) state.Full=false end
  updateRemote:FireClient(player,packet)
  state.Replies={} return
 end
 local packet=market:Snapshot(state.Owner,state.Contract,state.Timeframe,state.Full)
 packet.Seed=nil -- The server's future random stream is private.
 packet.CanTrade=world:CanRun() packet.ConnectionStatus=world:Label() packet.PersistenceMode=world.Mode
 -- Quotes/candles/P&L are frequent; unchanged order and trade histories are not resent.
 local orderParts={}
 for _,order in ipairs(packet.Orders)do
  table.insert(orderParts,table.concat({order.Id,order.Contract,order.Protection or "",order.Quantity,order.Price,order.Status},":"))
 end
 local orderSignature=table.concat(orderParts,"|")
 if not state.Full and state.SentRevision==packet.Revision and state.SentOwner==state.Owner then
  packet.History=nil packet.Fills=nil
 end
 -- OCO/trigger status can change before a closing execution changes the account revision.
 if not state.Full and state.SentOwner==state.Owner and state.SentOrders==orderSignature then
  packet.Orders=nil
 end
 for symbol,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes)do if symbol~=state.Contract then quote.Depth=nil end end
 state.SentRevision=packet.Revision state.SentOwner=state.Owner state.SentOrders=orderSignature
 packet.Regime=population.Regime.Name packet.News=market.Time<population.NewsUntil and population.News or nil
 packet.Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed packet.Replies=state.Replies
 packet.AccountKey=(funded:Profile(state.Uid) or {}).Active
 attachPortfolio(state,packet)
 updateRemote:FireClient(player,packet) state.Full=false state.Replies={}
end
local function reply(state,id,ok,message,result,extra)
 local r={RequestId=id,Ok=ok,Message=message,Result=result}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do r[k]=v end
 table.insert(state.Replies,r)
end
local allowed={Place=true,Cancel=true,Close=true,Subscribe=true,Account=true,AmendProtection=true,
 Start=true,Activate=true,Restart=true,Copy=true,Flag=true}
local fields={"Contract","Timeframe","Direction","Quantity","Type","Price","StopTicks","TargetTicks","OrderId","Protection","ExpectedPrice",
 "Key","Tier","Enabled","Leader","Followers","Sizing","Stage"}
requestRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,request)
 local state=clients[player]
 if not state or type(request)~="table" then return end
 local now=os.clock() state.Tokens=math.min(20,state.Tokens+(now-state.TokenTime)*6) state.TokenTime=now
 if state.Tokens<1 then return end state.Tokens-=1
 if type(request.Id)~="number" or request.Id%1~=0 or request.Id<1 or request.Id>1e9 or state.Seen[request.Id] then return end
 if not allowed[request.Action] then return end
 -- Whitelist scalar fields; do not accept account identities, execution prices, timestamps or copy links.
 local clean={Id=request.Id,Action=request.Action}
 for _,field in ipairs(fields) do
  local value=request[field]
  if value~=nil then
   if type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="string" then return end
   if type(value)=="number" and (value~=value or math.abs(value)>1e9) then return end
   if type(value)=="string" and #value>(field=="Followers" and 64 or 32) then return end
   clean[field]=value
  end
 end
 if #queue>=256 then reply(state,clean.Id,false,"Exchange busy. Please retry.") return end
 state.Seen[clean.Id]=true table.insert(state.SeenOrder,clean.Id)
 if #state.SeenOrder>256 then state.Seen[table.remove(state.SeenOrder,1)]=nil end
 if clean.Action=="Subscribe"then
  local valid=false for _,tf in ipairs(Config.Timeframes)do if tf[1]==clean.Timeframe then valid=true break end end
  if Config.Contracts[clean.Contract]and valid then
   state.Contract=clean.Contract state.Timeframe=clean.Timeframe state.Full=true state.Subscribed=true
   emit(player,state)
  end
  return
 end
 if not world:CanRun()then reply(state,clean.Id,false,world:Label())emit(player,state)return end
 sequence+=1 table.insert(queue,{Player=player,Request=clean,Sequence=sequence,Epoch=epoch})
end)
local function process(item)
 local state=clients[item.Player] if not state then return end
 if item.Epoch~=epoch then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,"Exchange reconnected. Please submit your order again.")return end
 local req=item.Request local uid=state.Uid
 -- Account lifecycle. Each is idempotent and validated against the saved profile.
 if req.Action=="Start" then
  local ok,message,created=funded:Start(uid)
  state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Start",Created=created}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Activate" then
  local ok,message=funded:Activate(uid,req.Tier)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Activate",Tier=req.Tier}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Account" then
  local ok,message=funded:Select(uid,req.Key)
  if ok then state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true end
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Account",Key=req.Key}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Restart" then
  local ok,message=funded:Restart(uid,req.Tier)
  if ok then state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true end
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Restart",Tier=req.Tier}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Copy" then
  local ok,message=funded:SetCopy(uid,req)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Copy"}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Flag" then
  local ok,message=funded:Flag(uid,req.Stage)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Flag",Stage=req.Stage}) return
 end
 -- Trading. The lead order executes first; copies then run through the same engine calls.
 local owner=state.Owner
 if not owner or not market.Accounts[owner] then reply(state,req.Id,false,"Start a funded account to trade.") return end
 if req.Action=="Place" and not Progression.LegacyTradable and funded:IsLegacyOwner(uid,owner) then
  reply(state,req.Id,false,"Legacy practice accounts are close-only. Trade a funded account instead.") return
 end
 local plan=funded:Plan(uid,owner)
 local context=plan and funded:Context(owner,req)
 local ok,result=Funded.Perform(market,owner,req)
 local copies=plan and funded:Mirror(plan,req,ok,result,context)
 market:ProcessStops()
 funded:Evaluate(uid)
 local message=type(result)=="table" and Funded.Describe(result) or result or "Request rejected."
 if copies and ok then message..=string.format(" · copied %d/%d",copies.Copied,copies.Total) end
 reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,type(result)=="table" and result or nil,{Kind=req.Action,Copies=copies})
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
 -- Accounts, resting orders and protection belong to the exchange, not the GUI connection.
 -- Leaving keeps risk and fills active; returning retrieves the same account.
 clients[player]=nil
end)
local routing={}
TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player)
 routing[player]=nil
 local state=clients[player]if state then state.NextRoute=os.clock()+10 end
end)
local function route(player,state)
 local owner=world.Owner
 if world.Studio or routing[player]or os.clock()<(state.NextRoute or 0)or not owner or
  owner.LeaseUntil<=os.time()or owner.JobId==""or owner.JobId==game.JobId then return end
 routing[player]=true state.NextRoute=os.clock()+15
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   local options=Instance.new("TeleportOptions")options.ServerInstanceId=owner.JobId
   TeleportService:TeleportAsync(owner.PlaceId,{player},options)
  end)
  if not ok then routing[player]=nil warn("[Get Funded!] Exchange transfer will retry: "..tostring(err))end
 end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)routing[player]=nil end)
task.spawn(function()world:Open()end)
game:BindToClose(function()world:Close()end)
local elapsed,broadcast,maintenance=0,0,0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 if epoch~=world.Epoch then
  epoch=world.Epoch market=world.Engine population=world.Population elapsed=0
  funded=market and Funded.new(market,Progression,Config) or nil
  for player,state in pairs(clients)do state.Owner=nil resolve(player,state) end
 end
 local active=world:CanRun()
 root:SetAttribute("Ready",active)root:SetAttribute("PersistenceStatus",world:Label())
 if active then elapsed+=dt*Config.SimulationSpeed else elapsed=0 end
 broadcast+=dt maintenance+=dt local steps=0
 while active and elapsed>=Config.StepSeconds and steps<Config.MaxCatchupSteps do
  elapsed-=Config.StepSeconds steps+=1
  local pending=queue queue={}
  for _,item in ipairs(pending) do
   table.insert(actionLog,{Step=market.Step,Sequence=item.Sequence,Player=item.Player.UserId,Request=item.Request})
   if #actionLog>5000 then table.remove(actionLog,1) end
   process(item)
  end
  population:Step()
 end
 if not active and #queue>0 then
  for _,item in ipairs(queue)do local state=clients[item.Player]if state then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,world:Label())end end
  queue={}
 end
 if maintenance>=1 then
  maintenance=0 task.spawn(function()world:Maintain()end)
  -- Resting orders and SL/TP can realize profit while a player is away; unlocks are still earned once.
  if active and funded then for uid in pairs(market.Profiles)do funded:Evaluate(uid)end end
  if world.Mode=="Following"then for player,state in pairs(clients)do route(player,state)end end
 end
 -- Do not skip simulation steps under load; catch up over subsequent frames.
 if broadcast>=Config.BroadcastSeconds then
  broadcast=broadcast%Config.BroadcastSeconds
  for player,state in pairs(clients) do if state.Subscribed then emit(player,state) end end
 end
end)
-- Read-only diagnostic access in Studio; never replicated to game clients.
if RunService:IsStudio() then
 local diagnostic=Instance.new("BindableFunction") diagnostic.Name="StudioDiagnostics" diagnostic.Parent=script.Parent
 diagnostic.OnInvoke=function(command,a,b)
  if command=="Tests" then return require(script.Parent.MarketTests).Run() end
  if command=="ContinuityTests"then return require(script.Parent.WorldTests).Run()end
  if command=="FundedTests"then return require(script.Parent.FundedTests).Run()end
  if command=="Actions" then return actionLog end
  if not market then return {Mode=world.Mode,Status=world:Label(),Error=world.LastError}end
  if command=="Profiles"then
   local views={} for uid in pairs(market.Profiles)do views[uid]={Saved=market.Profiles[uid],View=funded:View(uid)}end return views
  end
  if command=="SetUnlock"then
   -- Studio-only playtest aid: lower a tier's requirement for this server session. Never saved.
   for _,t in ipairs(Progression.Tiers)do if t.Id==a and type(b)=="number" and t.Unlock>0 then t.Unlock=b return true end end
   return false
  end
  local books={}
  for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder) do
   local book=market.Books[key]
   books[key]={Last=book.Last and book.Last*book.Spec.Tick,Volume=book.Volume,Up=book.Up,Down=book.Down,Bids=#book.Bids,Asks=#book.Asks,Candles=#book.Candles["1m"]}
  end
  local accounts={}
  for _,id in ipairs(market.AccountOrder) do local account=market.Accounts[id] if account.Player then accounts[id]=market:Snapshot(id,"MES","1m",false) end end
  return {Seed=market.Seed,Mode=world.Mode,Status=world:Label(),Step=market.Step,Time=market.Time,Audit=market:Audit(),Books=books,Accounts=accounts,Participants=#population.Agents,Regime=population.Regime.Name}
 end
end

local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Default=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Tests={}
local function config()
 local c=table.clone(Default) c.MaxTradeHistory=100000 c.MaxOrderHistory=100000 c.MaxCandles=10000 return c
end
local function fresh()
 local e=Engine.new(config(),123)
 for _,id in ipairs({"A","B","C","D"}) do e:AddAccount(id,1000000,500,0.9,false) end
 return e
end
local function place(e,id,side,qty,price,extra)
 local r={Contract="MES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit" or "Market",Price=price}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do r[k]=v end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(id,r) assert(ok,tostring(result)) return result
end
function Tests.Run()
 local report={} local function test(name,fn) local ok,result=pcall(fn) table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and result or tostring(result)}) end
 test("Price/time priority, partial fills, cancellation and no quote-driven price",function()
  local e=fresh() local a=place(e,"A",-1,3,5825) local b=place(e,"B",-1,4,5825) place(e,"C",-1,2,5824.75)
  assert(e.Books.MES.Last==nil) local fill=place(e,"D",1,4)
  assert(fill.Filled==4 and fill.Average==5824.875) assert(e.Orders[a.Id].Remaining==1 and e.Orders[b.Id].Remaining==4)
  assert(e.Trades[1].Seller=="C" and e.Trades[2].Seller=="A")
  local last=e.Books.MES.Last assert(e:Cancel("B",b.Id)) assert(e.Books.MES.Last==last)
  assert(not e:Cancel("C",a.Id)) e:Audit() return "Better price first, then FIFO; partial residual 1; ownership checked"
 end)
 test("Marketable limits honor their price cap and rest the residual",function()
  local e=fresh() place(e,"A",-1,2,5825) place(e,"B",-1,3,5825.5)
  local order=place(e,"C",1,5,5825.25)
  assert(order.Filled==2 and order.Remaining==3 and e.Orders[order.Id].Price==23301)
  assert(e.Books.MES.Asks[1].Price==23302)
  local follow=place(e,"D",-1,1)
  assert(follow.Filled==1 and e.Orders[order.Id].Remaining==2)
  assert(e:Cancel("C",order.Id)) e:Audit() return "Limit cap, later partial fill and residual cancellation passed"
 end)
 test("Thin liquidity increases impact; multi-level sweeps",function()
  local function sweep(depth)
   local e=fresh() for i=1,6 do place(e,"A",-1,depth,5825+(i-1)*0.25) end
   local r=place(e,"B",1,6) e:Audit() return r
  end
  local thin,deep=sweep(1),sweep(8)
  assert(thin.Average>deep.Average and thin.Slippage>deep.Slippage)
  return {ThinAverage=thin.Average,DeepAverage=deep.Average,ThinSlippage=thin.Slippage,DeepSlippage=deep.Slippage}
 end)
 test("Unfilled market remainder cancelled, self trades prevented",function()
  local e=fresh() place(e,"A",-1,2,5825) local r=place(e,"B",1,7)
  assert(r.Filled==2 and r.Cancelled==5 and r.Remaining==0)
  place(e,"B",-1,2,5825.25) local vol=e.TotalVolume place(e,"B",1,2)
  assert(e.TotalVolume==vol) e:Audit() return "IOC accounting and self-trade prevention passed"
 end)
 test("Stop cascade, partial protection, retry and OCO",function()
  local e=fresh() place(e,"A",-1,4,5825) place(e,"B",1,4,nil,{StopTicks=4,TargetTicks=8})
  place(e,"C",1,2,5824) place(e,"A",-1,1) e:ProcessStops()
  assert(e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES.Quantity==3 and e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES.Triggered=="Stop loss")
  assert(e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES.Target==nil,"OCO target must disappear while stop exit is partial")
  place(e,"D",1,3,5823.75) e:AdvanceClock(0.25)
  assert(not e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES) assert(e.Accounts.B.Realized<0)
  assert(#e:Snapshot("B","MES","1m",true).Orders==0) e:Audit() return "Stop remains latched through insufficient liquidity, never reverses"
 end)
 test("Take-profit long and short, entry averaging and realized P&L",function()
  local e=fresh() place(e,"A",-1,2,5825) place(e,"B",1,2,nil,{TargetTicks=4})
  place(e,"C",1,3,5826) place(e,"A",-1,1) e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES and e.Accounts.B.Realized==10)
  place(e,"C",1,2,5825) place(e,"B",-1,2,nil,{TargetTicks=4})
  place(e,"A",-1,3,5824) place(e,"D",1,1) e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES and e.Accounts.B.Realized==20) e:Audit()
  return "Both take-profit directions settle from real fills"
 end)
 test("Dragged SL and TP amend atomically and trigger from subsequent executions",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
    local e=fresh() place(e,"A",-side,2,5825) place(e,"B",side,2,nil,{StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=120})
    local p=e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES local opposite=field=="Stop"and"Target"or"Stop" local other=p[opposite]
    -- Move the market into profit so a stop beyond the entry is legal.
    place(e,"C",-side,1,5825+side*2) place(e,"D",side,1)
    local price=5825+side*(field=="Stop"and 1 or 3)
    local before=e:Audit() local revision=e.Accounts.B.Revision
    assert(e:AmendProtection("B",{Contract="MES",OrderId=p.Id,Protection=field,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=p[field]}))
    assert(p[field]==price and p[opposite]==other and e.Accounts.B.Revision==revision+1)
    assert(e:Audit().Hash==before.Hash and e.TotalVolume==3 and e.Books.MES.Last*0.25==5825+side*2)
    local snapshot=e:Snapshot("B","MES","1m",true) local found=false
    for _,order in ipairs(snapshot.Orders)do if order.Protection==field then assert(order.Price==price and order.Quantity==2);found=true end end assert(found)
    -- A new trade reaches the edited level; closing liquidity fills the protection.
    place(e,"C",side,3,price) place(e,"A",-side,1) e:ProcessStops()
    assert(not e.Accounts.B.Positions.MES and e.Accounts.B.Realized==side*(price-5825)*10)
    e:Audit()
   end
  end
  return "Long/short SL and TP, profitable stops, snapshots, OCO and fill-based exits passed"
 end)
 test("Protection edits reject invalid, stale, foreign and excessive-risk requests",function()
  local e=fresh() e:AddAccount("P",50000,40,0.8,true)
  place(e,"A",-1,2,5825) place(e,"P",1,2,nil,{StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=120})
  local p=e.Accounts.P.Positions.MES local original=p.Stop local revision=e.Accounts.P.Revision
  local function request(changes)
   local r={Contract="MES",OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=5820,ExpectedPrice=original}
   for key,value in pairs(changes or{})do r[key]=value end return r
  end
  for _,change in ipairs({{Price=0/0},{Price=math.huge},{Price=-1},{Price=5820.13},{Price=5825},{Price=5826},
   {Price=5200},{Price=5724.75},{ExpectedPrice=5814.75},{OrderId=p.Id+1},{Contract="MNQ"},{Protection="Entry"},
   {Protection="Target",ExpectedPrice=p.Target,Price=5824}})do
   assert(not e:AmendProtection("P",request(change)))
  end
  assert(not e:AmendProtection("B",request())) assert(not e:AmendProtection("Missing",request()))
  assert(p.Stop==original and e.Accounts.P.Revision==revision)
  assert(e:AmendProtection("P",request())) assert(not e:AmendProtection("P",request({Price=5821})))
  assert(e:CancelProtection("P",p.Id,"Target"))
  assert(not e:AmendProtection("P",request({Protection="Target",ExpectedPrice=5855,Price=5856})))
  place(e,"C",1,1,5820) place(e,"A",-1,1)
  assert(p.Triggered=="Stop loss")
  assert(not e:AmendProtection("P",request({ExpectedPrice=5820,Price=5819})))
  e:Audit() return "Invalid ticks, direction, ownership, stale versions, price band, risk, cancelled/triggered orders rejected"
 end)
 test("Validation, reserved margin, finite inventory and off-tick prices",function()
  local e=fresh() e:AddAccount("P",50000,40,0.8,true)
  assert(not e:Submit("P",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=1.5,Type="Market"}))
  assert(not e:Submit("P",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=5824.13}))
  assert(not e:Submit("P",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=0/0,Type="Market"}))
  assert(not e:Submit("P",{Contract="FAKE",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
  place(e,"P",1,20,5810)
  assert(not e:Submit("P",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=20,Type="Limit",Price=5810}))
  e:Audit() return "Working orders reserve capacity; invalid inputs rejected"
 end)
 test("Every candle timeframe agrees with the execution tape",function()
  local e=fresh()
  for i=1,80 do e:AdvanceClock(17) place(e,"A",-1,1,5824+(i%5)*0.25) place(e,"B",1,1) end
  for _,tf in ipairs(e.Config.Timeframes) do
   local groups={}
   for _,t in ipairs(e.Trades) do
    local bucket=math.floor(t.Time/tf[2])*tf[2] local c=groups[bucket]
    if not c then c={Open=t.Price,High=t.Price,Low=t.Price,Close=t.Price,Volume=0} groups[bucket]=c end
    c.High=math.max(c.High,t.Price) c.Low=math.min(c.Low,t.Price) c.Close=t.Price c.Volume+=t.Quantity
   end
   for _,c in ipairs(e.Books.MES.Candles[tf[1]]) do for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close","Volume"}) do assert(c[field]==groups[c.Time][field],tf[1].." "..field) end end
  end
  e:Audit() return "OHLCV independently reconstructed for 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h and 1D"
 end)
 test("Seeded participants and identical step-indexed player actions reproduce",function()
  local function run(seed)
   local c=config() c.ParticipantsPerInstrument=12 c.MakersPerInstrument=3 c.WhalesPerInstrument=2
   local e=Engine.new(c,seed) local bots=Participants.new(e) e:AddAccount("P",50000,40,0.8,true)
   for i=1,1000 do
    if i==80 or i==220 or i==500 then e:Submit("P",{Contract="MES",Direction=i==220 and -1 or 1,Quantity=2,Type="Market",StopTicks=12,TargetTicks=20}) end
    if i==600 then e:Submit("P",{Contract="MNQ",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=(e.Books.MNQ.Last+10)*0.25}) end
    if i==680 then e:CancelAll("P") end
    bots:Step()
   end
   return e,e:Audit()
  end
  local a,aa=run(73521) local b,bb=run(73521) local c,cc=run(73522)
  assert(aa.Hash==bb.Hash and a.NextTrade==b.NextTrade and a.TotalVolume==b.TotalVolume)
  for i,t in ipairs(a.Trades) do local other=b.Trades[i] for _,field in ipairs({"Step","Price","Quantity","Buyer","Seller","Contract"}) do assert(t[field]==other[field],"Replay differs: "..field) end end
  assert(aa.Hash~=cc.Hash)
  for _,key in ipairs(a.Config.ContractOrder) do assert(a.Books[key].Up>0 and a.Books[key].Down>0,"Missing two-way market") end
  return {Seed=73521,Hash=aa.Hash,DifferentSeedHash=cc.Hash,Trades=a.NextTrade,Volume=a.TotalVolume,CashError=aa.CashError,EquityError=aa.EquityError}
 end)
 local passed=0 for _,result in ipairs(report) do if result.Passed then passed+=1 end end
 return {Passed=passed,Total=#report,Results=report}
end
return Tests

FundedAccounts.Source:
-- Server-authoritative funded-account ladder, onboarding flags and optional copy trading.
-- Profiles live in engine.Profiles and are saved inside the same exchange checkpoint as balances,
-- so an unlock can never restore without the profit that earned it (and vice versa).
-- Every order, copied or not, is executed by MarketEngine with that account's own limits.
local Funded={} Funded.__index=Funded
local EPS=1e-6

local function money(n)
 local raw=string.format("%.2f",math.abs(n or 0)) local whole,decimal=raw:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
 whole=whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "").."$"..whole..(decimal=="00" and "" or "."..decimal)
end
Funded.Money=money
local function count(map) local n=0 for _ in pairs(map or {}) do n+=1 end return n end
local function sortedKeys(t) local keys={} for k in pairs(t) do table.insert(keys,k) end table.sort(keys) return keys end

function Funded.Validate(config)
 assert(type(config.Tiers)=="table" and #config.Tiers>0,"Progression needs at least one tier")
 local seen,prevSize,prevUnlock={},0,-1
 for i,t in ipairs(config.Tiers) do
  assert(type(t.Id)=="string" and #t.Id>0 and #t.Id<=8 and not t.Id:find("[,:]") and not t.Id:match("^L%d"),"Tier ids must be 1-8 characters without ',' or ':'")
  assert(not seen[t.Id],"Duplicate tier id "..t.Id) seen[t.Id]=true
  assert(t.Size>prevSize,"Tier sizes must ascend") assert(t.Unlock>prevUnlock,"Unlock requirements must ascend")
  assert((i==1)==(t.Unlock==0),"Only the first (starter) tier unlocks at 0")
  assert(t.LossLimit>0 and t.MaxContracts>=1,"Tier risk limits must be positive")
  prevSize,prevUnlock=t.Size,t.Unlock
 end
 assert(config.Tiers[1].Id==config.StarterTier,"StarterTier must be the first tier")
end

function Funded.new(engine,config,market)
 Funded.Validate(config)
 engine.Profiles=engine.Profiles or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=config,Market=market or engine.Config,Tiers={},Order={}},Funded)
 for i,t in ipairs(config.Tiers) do self.Tiers[t.Id]=t self.Order[i]=t.Id end
 return self
end
function Funded.Key(userId) return tostring(userId) end
function Funded:Group(uid) return "player:"..uid end
function Funded:LegacyId(uid,base) return "player:"..uid..":"..base end
function Funded:LegacyName(base) return "$"..(base%1000==0 and tostring(base//1000).."K" or tostring(base)).." Practice" end
function Funded:Profile(uid) return self.Engine.Profiles[uid] end
function Funded:_touch(p) p.Revision=(p.Revision or 0)+1 end
function Funded:_new(uid,migrated)
 local p={V=1,Tiers={},Ledger={},Legacy={},Tutorial="None",CopyIntro=false,Revision=1,Created=self.Engine.Time,Migrated=migrated,
  Copy={Enabled=false,Followers={},Sizing=self.Config.CopyTrading.DefaultSizing=="Proportional" and "Proportional" or "Same"}}
 self.Engine.Profiles[uid]=p
 return p
end

-- Called whenever a player joins or the exchange restores. A player with pre-ladder practice accounts
-- gets a migrated profile that keeps those accounts exactly as they were. New players get nothing
-- until they press Start, so no starter account is ever created implicitly.
function Funded:Join(uid)
 local e=self.Engine local p=e.Profiles[uid]
 if not p then
  local found={}
  for _,base in ipairs(self.Config.LegacyBases or {}) do if e.Accounts[self:LegacyId(uid,base)] then table.insert(found,base) end end
  if #found==0 then return nil end
  p=self:_new(uid,"practice-v1")
  for _,base in ipairs(found) do table.insert(p.Legacy,base) end
  p.Active="L"..found[1]
 end
 -- One player's accounts never trade against each other (cross-account self-trade prevention).
 for _,base in ipairs(p.Legacy) do local a=e.Accounts[self:LegacyId(uid,base)] if a then a.Group=self:Group(uid) end end
 return p
end

function Funded:Resolve(uid,key)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 if not p or type(key)~="string" then return nil end
 local legacy=tonumber(key:match("^L(%d+)$") or "")
 if legacy then
  for _,base in ipairs(p.Legacy) do
   if base==legacy and self.Engine.Accounts[self:LegacyId(uid,base)] then return self:LegacyId(uid,base),"Legacy",base end
  end
  return nil
 end
 local entry=p.Tiers[key]
 if entry and entry.State=="Active" and self.Engine.Accounts[entry.Account] then return entry.Account,"Funded",self.Tiers[key] end
 return nil
end
function Funded:Owner(uid)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 return p and p.Active and (self:Resolve(uid,p.Active)) or nil
end
function Funded:IsLegacyOwner(uid,owner)
 local _,kind=self:Resolve(uid,(self.Engine.Profiles[uid] or {}).Active)
 return kind=="Legacy" and owner==self:Owner(uid)
end
function Funded:_open(uid,p,tierId,attempt)
 local t=self.Tiers[tierId]
 local id="player:"..uid..":"..tierId..":"..attempt
 assert(not self.Engine.Accounts[id],"Funded account already exists")
 local a=self.Engine:AddAccount(id,t.Size,math.min(t.MaxContracts,self.Market.MaxPlayerInventory),self.Config.MarginUse,true)
 a.LossLimit=t.LossLimit a.Group=self:Group(uid) a.Tier=tierId
 table.insert(p.Ledger,id)
 return id
end
function Funded:ActiveTiers(p)
 local list={} for _,id in ipairs(self.Order) do local e=p.Tiers[id] if e and e.State=="Active" then table.insert(list,id) end end
 return list
end

function Funded:Start(uid)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid] or self:Join(uid) or self:_new(uid)
 local starter=self.Config.StarterTier local t=self.Tiers[starter]
 if p.Tiers[starter] then
  -- Idempotent: repeated or duplicated Start requests never create a second starter account.
  p.Active=starter self:_touch(p)
  return true,"Your "..t.Name.." account is ready.",false
 end
 local id=self:_open(uid,p,starter,1)
 p.Tiers[starter]={State="Active",Account=id,Attempt=1,UnlockedAt=self.Engine.Time,ActivatedAt=self.Engine.Time,Announced=true}
 p.Active=starter p.Tutorial="Pending" self:_touch(p)
 return true,"Your "..money(t.Size).." funded account is live. Trading and funds are simulated.",true
end

function Funded:Activate(uid,tierId)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 if not p or not p.Tiers[self.Config.StarterTier] then return false,"Start your funded account first." end
 local t=self.Tiers[tierId] if not t then return false,"Unknown account tier." end
 local entry=p.Tiers[tierId]
 if not entry then return false,t.Name.." unlocks at "..money(t.Unlock).." net realized profit." end
 if entry.State=="Active" then return true,t.Name.." is already active." end
 entry.Account=self:_open(uid,p,tierId,1)
 entry.State="Active" entry.Attempt=1 entry.ActivatedAt=self.Engine.Time entry.Announced=true
 self:_touch(p)
 return true,t.Name.." activated. Its "..money(t.Size).." is simulated funded capital, separate from your earned profits."
end

function Funded:Select(uid,key)
 local id,kind,info=self:Resolve(uid,key)
 if not id then return false,"That account isn't available." end
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid] p.Active=key self:_touch(p)
 return true,"Now trading "..(kind=="Legacy" and self:LegacyName(info) or info.Name).."."
end

function Funded:Restart(uid,tierId)
 if not self.Config.AllowRestart then return false,"Account restarts are disabled." end
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid] local entry=p and p.Tiers[tierId] local t=self.Tiers[tierId]
 if not entry or entry.State~="Active" then return false,"Only an active funded account can restart." end
 local old=self.Engine.Accounts[entry.Account]
 if not old.Locked then return false,t.Name.." is in good standing. Only a breached account can restart." end
 if next(old.Positions) or next(old.OpenOrders) then return false,"Wait for the breached account's remaining positions to close." end
 entry.Attempt+=1 entry.Account=self:_open(uid,p,tierId,entry.Attempt) entry.RestartedAt=self.Engine.Time
 -- Retired attempts stay in the ledger so their realized result keeps counting. Trim display-only data.
 old.Fills={} while #old.History>20 do table.remove(old.History) end
 self:_touch(p)
 return true,t.Name.." restarted with fresh simulated capital. Its earlier realized loss still counts toward net profit."
end

function Funded:SetCopy(uid,req)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 if not p or not p.Tiers[self.Config.StarterTier] then return false,"Start your funded account first." end
 local enabled=req.Enabled==1 or req.Enabled==true
 if not enabled then
  local was=p.Copy.Enabled p.Copy.Enabled=false self:_touch(p)
  return true,was and "Copy trading off. Every account keeps its positions and orders and now trades independently." or "Copy trading is off."
 end
 if #self:ActiveTiers(p)<self.Config.CopyTrading.MinAccounts then return false,"Activate a second funded account to use copy trading." end
 local leader=req.Leader
 if type(leader)~="string" or not self:Resolve(uid,leader) or not self.Tiers[leader] then return false,"Choose an active funded account to lead." end
 local chosen={}
 for key in string.gmatch(type(req.Followers)=="string" and req.Followers or "","[^,]+") do
  if not self.Tiers[key] or not self:Resolve(uid,key) then return false,"Followers must be your active funded accounts." end
  if key~=leader then chosen[key]=true end
 end
 local followers={} for _,id in ipairs(self.Order) do if chosen[id] then table.insert(followers,id) end end
 if #followers==0 then return false,"Choose at least one account to follow the lead." end
 local sizing=req.Sizing=="Proportional" and "Proportional" or req.Sizing=="Same" and "Same" or p.Copy.Sizing
 p.Copy={Enabled=true,Leader=leader,Followers=followers,Sizing=sizing} p.CopyIntro=true self:_touch(p)
 return true,string.format("Copy trading on. New %s orders copy to %d account%s. Existing positions are unchanged.",
  self.Tiers[leader].Short,#followers,#followers==1 and "" or "s")
end

function Funded:Flag(uid,stage)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid] if not p then return false,"Start your funded account first." end
 if stage=="TutorialDone" or stage=="TutorialSkipped" then
  if p.Tutorial=="Pending" then p.Tutorial=stage=="TutorialDone" and "Done" or "Skipped" end
 elseif stage=="CopyIntro" then p.CopyIntro=true
 else return false,"Unknown onboarding step." end
 self:_touch(p) return true,"Saved."
end

-- Net realized profit across every funded account the player has ever traded (including restarted
-- attempts). Account.Realized excludes the starting balance and open P&L by construction.
function Funded:Earned(p)
 local total=0
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do local a=self.Engine.Accounts[id] if a then total+=a.Realized end end
 return total
end

-- Unlocks are one-way, recorded once, and announced once (Announced flag is saved).
function Funded:Evaluate(uid)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 if not p or not p.Tiers[self.Config.StarterTier] then return false end
 local earned,changed=self:Earned(p),false
 for _,id in ipairs(self.Order) do
  if not p.Tiers[id] and earned+EPS>=self.Tiers[id].Unlock then
   p.Tiers[id]={State="Unlocked",UnlockedAt=self.Engine.Time,Earned=earned,Announced=false} changed=true
  end
 end
 if not p.FirstProfit then
  for _,accountId in ipairs(p.Ledger) do
   local a=self.Engine.Accounts[accountId]
   for _,h in ipairs(a and a.History or {}) do
    if h.Pnl>EPS then p.FirstProfit={Pnl=h.Pnl,Contract=h.Contract,At=self.Engine.Time,Announced=false} changed=true break end
   end
   if p.FirstProfit then break end
  end
 end
 if changed then self:_touch(p) end
 return changed
end
function Funded:TakeEvents(uid)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid] if not p then return nil end
 local events={}
 if p.FirstProfit and p.FirstProfit.Announced==false then
  p.FirstProfit.Announced=true table.insert(events,{Kind="FirstProfit",Pnl=p.FirstProfit.Pnl,Contract=p.FirstProfit.Contract})
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(self.Order) do
  local entry=p.Tiers[id]
  if entry and entry.Announced==false then
   entry.Announced=true local t=self.Tiers[id]
   table.insert(events,{Kind="Unlocked",Tier=id,Name=t.Name,Short=t.Short,Size=t.Size,Unlock=t.Unlock,Earned=self:Earned(p)})
  end
 end
 if #events==0 then return nil end
 self:_touch(p) return events
end

function Funded:View(uid)
 local e=self.Engine local p=e.Profiles[uid]
 if not p then return {New=true,Revision=0} end
 local earned=self:Earned(p)
 local view={Revision=p.Revision,Active=p.Active,Tutorial=p.Tutorial,CopyIntro=p.CopyIntro,Migrated=p.Migrated~=nil,
  Started=p.Tiers[self.Config.StarterTier]~=nil,Earned=earned,Capital=0,Open=0,Accounts={},Legacy={},ActiveCount=0,
  FirstProfit=p.FirstProfit and p.FirstProfit.Pnl or nil,
  Copy={Enabled=p.Copy.Enabled,Leader=p.Copy.Leader,Followers=table.clone(p.Copy.Followers),Sizing=p.Copy.Sizing}}
 for _,id in ipairs(self.Order) do
  local t=self.Tiers[id] local entry=p.Tiers[id]
  -- A player who has not started yet (e.g. migrated from practice accounts) sees the starter as "Start".
  local row={Key=id,Name=t.Name,Short=t.Short,Size=t.Size,Unlock=t.Unlock,LossLimit=t.LossLimit,MaxContracts=t.MaxContracts,
   State=entry and entry.State or (id==self.Config.StarterTier and "Start" or "Locked")}
  if entry and entry.State=="Active" then
   local a=e.Accounts[entry.Account] local s=e:Summary(a)
   row.Balance=s.Balance row.Equity=s.Equity row.Unrealized=s.Unrealized row.Realized=a.Realized row.Allowance=s.Allowance
   row.Positions=s.Count row.Orders=count(a.OpenOrders) row.Breached=a.Locked row.Attempt=entry.Attempt
   view.Capital+=t.Size view.Open+=s.Unrealized view.ActiveCount+=1
  end
  if p.Copy.Enabled and row.State=="Active" then
   if p.Copy.Leader==id then row.Role="Lead" elseif table.find(p.Copy.Followers,id) then row.Role="Follow" end
  end
  if not entry and not view.Next and t.Unlock>0 then view.Next={Key=id,Name=t.Name,Short=t.Short,Unlock=t.Unlock,Remaining=math.max(0,t.Unlock-earned)} end
  table.insert(view.Accounts,row)
 end
 view.CopyAvailable=view.ActiveCount>=self.Config.CopyTrading.MinAccounts
 for _,base in ipairs(p.Legacy) do
  local a=e.Accounts[self:LegacyId(uid,base)]
  if a then
   local s=e:Summary(a)
   table.insert(view.Legacy,{Key="L"..base,Name=self:LegacyName(base),Size=base,Balance=s.Balance,Equity=s.Equity,Unrealized=s.Unrealized,
    Realized=a.Realized,Allowance=s.Allowance,Positions=s.Count,Orders=count(a.OpenOrders),Breached=a.Locked})
  end
 end
 local _,kind,info=self:Resolve(uid,p.Active)
 if kind=="Funded" then view.ActiveName=info.Name view.ActiveShort=info.Short view.ActiveSize=info.Size view.ActiveKind="Funded"
 elseif kind=="Legacy" then view.ActiveName=self:LegacyName(info) view.ActiveShort=self:LegacyName(info) view.ActiveSize=info view.ActiveKind="Legacy"
 else view.Active=nil end
 return view
end

-- Shared trade execution: identical for lead, copied and independent orders.
function Funded.Perform(engine,owner,req)
 local a=engine.Accounts[owner]
 if not a then return false,"Unknown account." end
 if req.Action=="Place" then return engine:Submit(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="AmendProtection" then return engine:AmendProtection(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="Cancel" then
  if type(req.OrderId)~="number" then return false,"Unknown order." end
  if req.Protection then return engine:CancelProtection(owner,req.OrderId,req.Protection) end
  return engine:Cancel(owner,req.OrderId)
 elseif req.Action=="Close" then
  local p=a.Positions[req.Contract]
  if not p then return false,"No open position." end
  engine:CancelAll(owner,req.Contract)
  -- Latched close survives a partial fill/empty book and cannot reverse the position.
  p.Triggered="Player close" p.Stop=nil p.Target=nil
  return engine:Submit(owner,{Contract=req.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=math.min(p.Quantity,engine.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
 end
 return false,"Request rejected."
end
function Funded.Describe(result)
 local message=result.Filled>0 and string.format("Filled %d @ %.2f · slippage %+.2f pts",result.Filled,result.Average,result.Slippage) or result.Status
 if result.Remaining>0 then message..=" · "..result.Remaining.." working" end
 if result.Cancelled>0 then message..=" · "..result.Cancelled.." unfilled" end
 return message
end
function Funded.Size(quantity,leaderSize,followerSize,sizing,maximum)
 local n=sizing=="Proportional" and math.floor(quantity*followerSize/leaderSize+1e-9) or quantity
 return math.min(n,maximum)
end

-- Copy plan for an order from this account; nil unless copying is enabled and it is the lead.
function Funded:Plan(uid,owner)
 local p=self.Engine.Profiles[uid]
 if not p or not p.Copy.Enabled then return nil end
 local lead=p.Tiers[p.Copy.Leader]
 if not lead or lead.State~="Active" or lead.Account~=owner then return nil end
 local followers={}
 for _,key in ipairs(p.Copy.Followers) do
  local entry=p.Tiers[key]
  if entry and entry.State=="Active" and entry.Account~=owner and self.Engine.Accounts[entry.Account] then
   table.insert(followers,{Key=key,Id=entry.Account,Tier=self.Tiers[key]})
  end
 end
 if #followers==0 then return nil end
 return {Leader=self.Tiers[p.Copy.Leader],Followers=followers,Sizing=p.Copy.Sizing}
end
-- Captured before the lead action runs: a close or protective change needs the lead's prior position.
function Funded:Context(owner,req)
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[owner] if not a then return {} end
 if req.Action=="Close" then local p=a.Positions[req.Contract] return {Contract=req.Contract,Direction=p and p.Direction} end
 if req.Action=="AmendProtection" or (req.Action=="Cancel" and req.Protection) then
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Engine.Config.ContractOrder) do local p=a.Positions[key] if p and p.Id==req.OrderId then return {Contract=key,Direction=p.Direction} end end
 end
 return {}
end
function Funded:Mirror(plan,req,ok,result,context)
 if not plan then return nil end
 local e=self.Engine local items={}
 local function add(f,status,message) table.insert(items,{Key=f.Key,Name=f.Tier.Short,Status=status,Message=message}) end
 for _,f in ipairs(plan.Followers) do
  local account=e.Accounts[f.Id] local action=req.Action
  if not ok then add(f,"Skipped","Lead request was rejected, so nothing was copied.")
  elseif action=="Place" then
   local quantity=Funded.Size(req.Quantity,plan.Leader.Size,f.Tier.Size,plan.Sizing,e.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity)
   if quantity<1 then add(f,"Skipped","Rounds to 0 contracts at proportional size.")
   else
    local copyOk,copy=e:Submit(f.Id,{Contract=req.Contract,Direction=req.Direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=req.Type,Price=req.Price,
     StopTicks=req.StopTicks,TargetTicks=req.TargetTicks,Link=type(result)=="table" and result.Id or nil})
    if not copyOk then add(f,"Rejected",copy)
    elseif copy.Filled==0 and copy.Remaining==0 then add(f,"Rejected",copy.Status)
    else add(f,"Copied",Funded.Describe(copy)) end
   end
  elseif action=="Close" then
   local p=account.Positions[req.Contract]
   if not context.Direction or not p or p.Direction~=context.Direction then add(f,"Skipped","No matching "..req.Contract.." position.")
   else
    local copyOk,copy=Funded.Perform(e,f.Id,{Action="Close",Contract=req.Contract})
    add(f,copyOk and "Copied" or "Rejected",type(copy)=="table" and Funded.Describe(copy) or copy)
   end
  elseif action=="Cancel" and not req.Protection then
   local cancelled=0
   for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(account.OpenOrders)) do
    local o=e.Orders[id] if o and o.Link==req.OrderId and e:Cancel(f.Id,id) then cancelled+=1 end
   end
   if cancelled>0 then add(f,"Copied","Cancelled "..cancelled.." linked order"..(cancelled==1 and "" or "s")..".")
   else add(f,"Skipped","No linked order still working.") end
  elseif action=="AmendProtection" or action=="Cancel" then
   local field=req.Protection local label=field=="Stop" and "SL" or "TP"
   local p=context.Contract and account.Positions[context.Contract]
   if not p or p.Direction~=context.Direction or p.Triggered or not p[field] then add(f,"Skipped","No matching "..label.." to update.")
   elseif action=="AmendProtection" then
    local copyOk,copy=e:AmendProtection(f.Id,{Contract=context.Contract,OrderId=p.Id,Protection=field,Price=req.Price,ExpectedPrice=p[field]})
    add(f,copyOk and "Copied" or "Rejected",copy)
   else
    local copyOk,copy=e:CancelProtection(f.Id,p.Id,field)
    add(f,copyOk and "Copied" or "Rejected",copy)
   end
  end
 end
 local report={Leader=plan.Leader.Short,Action=req.Action,Items=items,Copied=0,Skipped=0,Rejected=0,Total=#items,Sizing=plan.Sizing}
 for _,item in ipairs(items) do report[item.Status]+=1 end
 return report
end
return Funded

-- One durable record owns both the checkpoint and its writer lease. UpdateAsync fences stale servers.
local Lease={} Lease.__index=Lease
function Lease.new(store,settings,identity,clock)
 return setmetatable({Store=store,Settings=settings,Identity=identity,Now=clock or os.time,Record=nil,Owned=false},Lease)
end
function Lease:Claim()
 local observed
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  if old then assert(old.Version==1,"Unsupported exchange ownership record")end
  observed=old
  local now=self.Now()
  if old and old.LeaseUntil>now and old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then return nil end
  local nextRecord=old and table.clone(old)or{Version=1,WorldId=self.Identity.WorldId,Generation=0,SaveSequence=0,SavedStep=0}
  if nextRecord.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then nextRecord.Generation+=1 end
  nextRecord.Owner=self.Identity.Token nextRecord.JobId=self.Identity.JobId nextRecord.PlaceId=self.Identity.PlaceId
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  return nextRecord
 end)
 self.Record=result or observed
 self.Owned=result~=nil and result.Owner==self.Identity.Token
 return self.Owned,self.Record
end
function Lease:Valid()
 return self.Owned and self.Record~=nil and self.Now()<self.Record.LeaseUntil-self.Settings.SafetySeconds
end
function Lease:Commit(checkpoint,step,release)
 assert(self.Owned and self.Record,"This server does not own the exchange")
 assert(type(checkpoint)=="table"and type(step)=="number","A complete checkpoint is required")
 local generation=self.Record.Generation
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  local now=self.Now()
  if not old or old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token or old.Generation~=generation or old.LeaseUntil<=now or step<old.SavedStep then return nil end
  local nextRecord=table.clone(old)
  nextRecord.Checkpoint=checkpoint nextRecord.SavedStep=step nextRecord.SavedAt=now nextRecord.SaveSequence+=1
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=release and 0 or now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  if release then nextRecord.Owner="" nextRecord.JobId=""end
  return nextRecord
 end)
 if not result then self.Owned=false;error("Exchange ownership changed; stale checkpoint rejected")end
 self.Record=result self.Owned=not release
 return result
end
return Lease

-- Lossless execution state, including FIFO identity and the participants' next random draw.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Encoding=game:GetService("EncodingService")
-- Version 2 adds funded-account profiles (onboarding, ladder, copy settings). Version 1 checkpoints
-- still restore; their players are migrated from the restored practice accounts on join.
-- Older servers cannot read version 2, so they fail closed instead of saving without profiles.
local Checkpoint={Version=2,Readable={[1]=true,[2]=true}}
local function digest(raw)
 local bytes=Encoding:ComputeStringHash(raw,Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256)
 return (bytes:gsub(".",function(c)return string.format("%02x",string.byte(c))end))
end
local function clone(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={} for key,v in pairs(value)do result[key]=clone(v)end return result
end
local function compatible(saved,current)
 assert(saved.StepSeconds==current.StepSeconds,"Saved market step size differs from configuration")
 assert(#saved.ContractOrder==#current.ContractOrder,"Saved instruments differ from configuration")
 for index,key in ipairs(current.ContractOrder)do
  local a,b=saved.Contracts[key],current.Contracts[key]
  assert(saved.ContractOrder[index]==key and a and a.Tick==b.Tick and a.Multiplier==b.Multiplier and a.Margin==b.Margin,"Saved contract specification changed: "..key)
 end
 assert(#saved.Timeframes==#current.Timeframes,"Saved timeframes differ")
 for i,tf in ipairs(current.Timeframes)do assert(saved.Timeframes[i][1]==tf[1]and saved.Timeframes[i][2]==tf[2],"Saved timeframe changed")end
end
function Checkpoint.Capture(engine,population)
 local e={Accounts={},Books={},Orders={},Profiles=clone(engine.Profiles or {})}
 for _,key in ipairs({"Seed","Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do e[key]=clone(engine[key])end
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder)do
  local a=clone(engine.Accounts[id]);a.OpenOrders=nil
  -- Bot histories are display-only; balances, cash ledger and inventory are retained exactly.
  if not a.Player then a.History={} a.Fills={}end
  table.insert(e.Accounts,a)
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(engine.Config.ContractOrder)do
  local book={}
  for field,value in pairs(engine.Books[key])do if field~="Bids"and field~="Asks"and field~="Spec"then book[field]=clone(value)end end
  e.Books[key]=book
 end
 local ids={}for id in pairs(engine.Orders)do table.insert(ids,id)end table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do table.insert(e.Orders,clone(engine.Orders[id]))end
 local p={RandomState=population.Random.State}
 for key,value in pairs(population)do if key~="Engine"and key~="Config"and key~="Random"then p[key]=clone(value)end end
 return {Version=Checkpoint.Version,Config=clone(engine.Config),Engine=e,Population=p}
end
function Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,currentConfig)
 assert(type(snapshot)=="table"and Checkpoint.Readable[snapshot.Version],"Unsupported saved market format")
 compatible(snapshot.Config,currentConfig)
 -- Preserve the saved simulation configuration for exact continuation; presentation cadence may change.
 local config=clone(snapshot.Config)
 -- MaxCandles only bounds chart history (matching never reads candles), so a restored world adopts the current limit.
 for _,key in ipairs({"BroadcastSeconds","SimulationSpeed","MaxCatchupSteps","MaxCandles"})do config[key]=currentConfig[key]end
 local data=snapshot.Engine local engine=Engine.new(config,data.Seed)
 for _,key in ipairs({"Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do engine[key]=clone(data[key])end
 for _,a in ipairs(data.Accounts)do
  local account=clone(a);account.OpenOrders={}
  assert(not engine.Accounts[a.Id],"Duplicate saved account")
  engine.Accounts[a.Id]=account table.insert(engine.AccountOrder,a.Id)
 end
 for key,fields in pairs(data.Books)do for name,value in pairs(fields)do engine.Books[key][name]=clone(value)end end
 engine.Profiles=clone(data.Profiles or {})
 for uid,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles)do
  assert(type(uid)=="string"and type(profile)=="table"and type(profile.Tiers)=="table"and type(profile.Ledger)=="table","Invalid saved funded profile")
  for _,id in ipairs(profile.Ledger)do assert(engine.Accounts[id],"Saved funded account missing")end
 end
 local prior=0
 for _,order in ipairs(data.Orders)do
  local o=clone(order)
  assert(o.Id>prior and o.Remaining>0 and engine.Accounts[o.Owner]and engine.Books[o.Contract],"Invalid saved resting order")
  prior=o.Id engine.Orders[o.Id]=o engine.Accounts[o.Owner].OpenOrders[o.Id]=true engine:_rest(engine.Books[o.Contract],o)
 end
 local population=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=config},Participants)
 for key,value in pairs(snapshot.Population)do if key~="RandomState"then population[key]=clone(value)end end
 population.Random=Participants.RNG.new(1);population.Random.State=snapshot.Population.RandomState
 assert(type(population.Random.State)=="number"and population.Random.State>0 and population.Random.State<2147483647,"Invalid saved random state")
 for _,agent in ipairs(population.Agents)do assert(engine.Accounts[agent.Id],"Saved participant account missing")end
 engine:Audit()
 return engine,population
end
function Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot)
 local raw=Http:JSONEncode(snapshot)
 local compressed=Encoding:CompressBuffer(buffer.fromstring(raw),Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd,3)
 return {Version=Checkpoint.Version,Codec="zstd-base64",RawBytes=#raw,
  Digest=digest(raw),
  Payload=buffer.tostring(Encoding:Base64Encode(compressed))}
end
function Checkpoint.Decode(record)
 assert(Checkpoint.Readable[record.Version] and record.Codec=="zstd-base64","Invalid checkpoint encoding")
 local compressed=Encoding:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(record.Payload))
 local bytes=Encoding:GetDecompressedBufferSize(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
 assert(bytes and bytes==record.RawBytes and bytes<=32000000,"Invalid checkpoint length")
 local raw=buffer.tostring(Encoding:DecompressBuffer(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd))
 assert(digest(raw)==record.Digest,"Checkpoint checksum failed")
 return Http:JSONDecode(raw)
end
return Checkpoint

local Pool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
return function()
 local root=Instance.new("Frame") local pool=Pool.new(root)
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local function mark(x,identity,animate)
   pool:Begin(animate)
   local object=pool:Get("Frame","Candle",root)
   pool:Props(object,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,20)},identity)
   pool:Finish();return object
  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)
  assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==450 and not next(pool.Moving),"Dragging must follow the pointer without tween lag")
  mark(500,120,true);pool:Step(.01);pool:Begin(true);pool:Finish()
  assert(not candle.Visible)
  mark(500,120,true);assert(candle.Visible and candle.Position.X.Offset==500,"Hidden animation cannot resume with stale geometry")
  pool:Begin(false);local row=pool:Dash(root,0,30,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position
  pool:Begin(false);local same=pool:Dash(root,0,80,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")
  -- Keyed objects: a candle keeps its own object whatever order candles are drawn in.
  local keyed=Pool.new(root)
  local function draw(times)
   keyed:Begin(false) local out={}
   for _,t in ipairs(times)do out[t]=keyed:Get("Frame","KeyedCandle",root,t)end
   keyed:Finish() return out
  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})
  assert(a[120]==b[120] and a[180]==b[180] and b[240]~=a[60],"Keyed objects follow their identity")
  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")
  local c=draw({60}) assert(c[60]==a[60] and c[60].Visible,"Returning candles reuse their object")
  for _=1,5 do draw({60}) end keyed:Prune(3)
  assert(a[120].Parent==nil and c[60].Parent==root,"Long-unused keyed objects are destroyed")
  return {Passed=true,Cases=10,Checks="Reuse, intermediate motion, exact settlement, candle identity, immediate drag, hidden motion, grouped dash resizing, keyed identity, keyed hiding, pruning"}
 end)
 root:Destroy();if not ok then error(result)end;return result
end
