local Default=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Lease=require(script.Parent.WorldLease)
local World=require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local Settings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local Tests={}
local function clone(v)
 if type(v)~="table"then return v end
 local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r
end
local function equal(a,b,path)
 path=path or "state"
 assert(type(a)==type(b),path.." type differs")
 if type(a)~="table"then assert(a==b,path.." differs: "..tostring(a).." / "..tostring(b))return end
 for k,v in pairs(a)do equal(v,b[k],path.."."..tostring(k))end
 for k in pairs(b)do assert(a[k]~=nil,path.." added key "..tostring(k))end
end
local function store()
 local s={}
 function s:UpdateAsync(_,callback)
  if self.Fail then error("Injected storage outage")end
  local value=callback(clone(self.Value))
  if value==nil then return nil end
  self.Value=clone(value)return clone(value)
 end
 function s:GetAsync()if self.Fail then error("Injected storage outage")end return clone(self.Value)end
 return s
end
function Tests.Run()
 local report={} local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,result=pcall(fn)table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and result or tostring(result)})
 end
 test("Compressed checkpoint resumes the identical future with identical actions",function()
  local e=Engine.new(Default,92041)local p=Participants.new(e)
  e:AddAccount("player:test:50000",50000,40,0.8,true)
  for _=1,500 do p:Step()end
  assert(e:Submit("player:test:50000",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=2,Type="Market",StopTicks=80,TargetTicks=100}))
  local before=Checkpoint.Capture(e,p)local encoded=Checkpoint.Encode(before)
  local http=game:GetService("HttpService")encoded=http:JSONDecode(http:JSONEncode(encoded))
  local restored,agents=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(encoded),Default)
  equal(before,Checkpoint.Capture(restored,agents))
  for i=1,700 do
   if i==200 or i==480 then
    local request={Contract="MNQ",Direction=i==200 and -1 or 1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}
    local ok1,r1=e:Submit("player:test:50000",request)local ok2,r2=restored:Submit("player:test:50000",request)
    equal({ok1,r1},{ok2,r2})
   end
   p:Step()agents:Step()
  end
  equal(Checkpoint.Capture(e,p),Checkpoint.Capture(restored,agents)) e:Audit()restored:Audit()
  return {Step=e.Step,Trades=e.NextTrade,Hash=e.TradeHash,CompressedBytes=#encoded.Payload,RawBytes=encoded.RawBytes}
 end)
 test("Restored book retains FIFO, partial fills, cancellations, account funds and protection",function()
  local e=Engine.new(Default,19)
  for _,id in ipairs({"a","b","c"})do e:AddAccount(id,1000000,500,0.8,true)end
  local function order(who,side,qty,price)
   local ok,r=e:Submit(who,{Contract="MES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit"or"Market",Price=price,StopTicks=8,TargetTicks=12})
   assert(ok,tostring(r))return r
  end
  local first=order("a",-1,4,5825)local second=order("b",-1,3,5825)
  order("c",1,2)
  local p=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=Default,Random=Participants.RNG.new(19),Agents={}},Participants)
  local r=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(Checkpoint.Encode(Checkpoint.Capture(e,p))),Default)
  assert(r.Orders[first.Id].Remaining==2 and r.Orders[second.Id].Remaining==3)
  assert(r.Books.MES.Asks[1].Orders[1]==r.Orders[first.Id],"Restored order references are detached")
  local account=r.Accounts.c local originalBase=account.Balance
  assert(r:AddAccount("c",50000,40,0.8,true)==account and account.Balance==originalBase,"Rejoin reset funds")
  assert(account.Positions.MES.Stop and account.Positions.MES.Target)
  local ok,fill=r:Submit("c",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=3,Type="Market"})
  assert(ok and fill.Filled==3 and r.Trades[1].Seller=="a"and r.Trades[2].Seller=="b")
  assert(not r.Orders[first.Id]and r.Orders[second.Id].Remaining==2)
  assert(r:Cancel("b",second.Id))assert(#r.Books.MES.Asks==0)
  r:Audit()return "FIFO object identity, partial residual, cancellation, persistent account and SL/TP passed"
 end)
 test("Ownership is exclusive; takeover fences stale writes and preserves the checkpoint",function()
  local s=store()local now=100 local function clock()return now end
  local function owner(id)return Lease.new(s,Settings,{Token=id,WorldId=id,JobId=id,PlaceId=1},clock)end
  local a,b=owner("a"),owner("b")assert(a:Claim())assert(not b:Claim())
  a:Commit({Marker="saved"},18,false)now=191
  assert(not a:Valid())assert(b:Claim())assert(b.Record.Checkpoint.Marker=="saved")
  assert(not pcall(function()a:Commit({Marker="stale"},999,false)end))
  assert(s.Value.Owner=="b"and s.Value.SavedStep==18 and s.Value.Checkpoint.Marker=="saved")
  b:Commit({Marker="new"},22,true)local c=owner("c")assert(c:Claim())
  assert(c.Record.SavedStep==22 and c.Record.Checkpoint.Marker=="new")
  assert(not pcall(function()c:Commit({Marker="backwards"},21,false)end))
  return "Single writer, expired lease, stale generation, release and monotonic checkpoint verified"
 end)
 test("World service restart restores live accounts, candles and next random draw without a new auction",function()
  local c=table.clone(Default)c.WarmupSeconds=12
  local s=store()local now=1000
  local function make(job)return World.new(c,{Studio=false,PlaceId=123,JobId=job,Store=s,Now=function()return now end,CanOwn=true})end
  local a=make("first")a:Open()assert(a:CanRun(),a.LastError)
  a.Engine:AddAccount("player:7:50000",50000,40,0.8,true)
  a.Engine:Submit("player:7:50000",{Contract="MES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopTicks=50,TargetTicks=100})
  for _=1,40 do a.Population:Step()end
  local expected=Checkpoint.Capture(a.Engine,a.Population)
  assert(a:Close())local b=make("second")b:Open()assert(b:CanRun(),b.LastError)
  equal(expected,Checkpoint.Capture(b.Engine,b.Population))
  local follower=make("third")follower:Open()
  assert(follower.Mode=="Following"and not follower.Engine and not follower:CanRun())
  assert(follower.Owner.JobId=="second")
  return {RestoredStep=b.Engine.Step,RestoredTrades=b.Engine.NextTrade,Mode=b.Mode,Follower=follower.Mode}
 end)
 test("Storage outage pauses orders and never creates a replacement market",function()
  local c=table.clone(Default)c.WarmupSeconds=1
  local s=store()local now=2000 local opts={Studio=false,PlaceId=123,JobId="outage",Store=s,Now=function()return now end,CanOwn=true}
  s.Fail=true local unavailable=World.new(c,opts)unavailable:Open()
  assert(unavailable.Mode=="Unavailable"and not unavailable.Engine and not unavailable:CanRun())
  s.Fail=false local w=World.new(c,opts)w:Open()assert(w:CanRun())
  local step=w.Engine.Step s.Fail=true assert(not w:Save(false))assert(not w:CanRun())
  assert(w.Engine.Step==step and s.Value.SavedStep==step)
  s.Fail=false now+=Settings.RetrySeconds w:Maintain()assert(w:CanRun())
  now=w.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil+1 assert(not w:CanRun())
  return "Initial failure fails closed; save failure pauses; retry recovers; expired owner cannot trade"
 end)
 test("Corrupt or incompatible checkpoints are rejected instead of reseeded",function()
  local e=Engine.new(Default,202)local p=Participants.new(e)
  local snapshot=Checkpoint.Capture(e,p)local encoded=Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot)
  encoded.Digest="bad"assert(not pcall(Checkpoint.Decode,encoded))
  snapshot.Config.Contracts.MES.Tick=1
  assert(not pcall(Checkpoint.Restore,snapshot,Default))
  return "Checksum and instrument-schema validation passed"
 end)
 return report
end
return Tests

ChartTools.Source:
-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.SnapRadius={Mouse=14,Touch=24}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- Nearest candle open/high/low/close within a screen-space radius.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y,radius)
 local best,bestD=nil,radius
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if math.abs(cx-x)<=radius then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=math.sqrt((cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2)
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- Handles belong to the selected drawing only; interiors of unselected rectangles are reported
-- separately so a drag there still pans the chart (click selects).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end
 local interior
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Line" then
   if math.abs(toY(d.P1)-y)<=tolerance and x>=0 and x<=(width or math.huge) then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then
   if segmentDistance(x,y,toX(d.T1),toY(d.P1),toX(d.T2),toY(d.P2))<=tolerance then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Rect" then
   local x1,x2=math.min(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2))
   local y1,y2=math.min(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2)),math.max(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2))
   local inside=x>=x1-tolerance and x<=x2+tolerance and y>=y1-tolerance and y<=y2+tolerance
   if inside then
    local edge=math.abs(x-x1)<=tolerance or math.abs(x-x2)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y1)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y2)<=tolerance
    if edge or d.Id==selectedId then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
    interior=interior or {Drawing=d,Part="Move",Interior=true}
   end
  end
 end
 return interior
end
-- Applies an edit to `target` from its unmodified `original`.
function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)
 for k,v in pairs(original)do target[k]=v end
 if part=="Move" then
  target.T1=original.T1 and original.T1+delta.Time target.P1=original.P1+delta.Price
  if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time target.P2=original.P2+delta.Price end
 elseif part=="P1" or part=="P2" then
  local n=part:sub(2) target["T"..n]=point.Time target["P"..n]=point.Price
 else
  local index=tonumber(part:match("Corner(%d)"))
  if index then
   local f=cornerFields[index] target[f[1]]=point.Time target[f[2]]=point.Price
  end
 end
end
-- Liang-Barsky clip to [0,w]x[0,h]. Rotated GUI objects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants.
function Tools.ClipSegment(x1,y1,x2,y2,w,h)
 local t0,t1=0,1 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
 for _,edge in ipairs({{-dx,x1},{dx,w-x1},{-dy,y1},{dy,h-y1}})do
  local p,q=edge[1],edge[2]
  if p==0 then if q<0 then return nil end
  else
   local r=q/p
   if p<0 then if r>t1 then return nil elseif r>t0 then t0=r end
   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end
  end
 end
 return x1+t0*dx,y1+t0*dy,x1+t1*dx,y1+t1*dy
end
-- Undo/redo of the whole drawing list (small, so snapshots are simple and exact).
local History={} History.__index=History
function Tools.History(limit) return setmetatable({Past={},Future={},Limit=limit or 100},History) end
function History:Record(list)
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
local function restore(list,snapshot) table.clear(list) for i,d in ipairs(snapshot)do list[i]=copy(d) end end
-- Records a snapshot taken before an edit that has already been applied (e.g. a finished drag).
function History:Push(snapshot)
 table.insert(self.Past,snapshot) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
function History:Undo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Past) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Future,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:Redo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Future) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:CanUndo() return #self.Past>0 end
function History:CanRedo() return #self.Future>0 end
-- Candle direction from exact tick counts: 1 up, -1 down, 0 doji. Independent of the viewport.
function Tools.Direction(candle,tick)
 local o=math.round(candle.Open/tick) local c=math.round(candle.Close/tick)
 return c>o and 1 or c<o and -1 or 0
end
return Tools

WorldService.Source:
-- A single shared exchange. Follower servers route players to its owner instead of creating another tape.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Lease=require(script.Parent.WorldLease)
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Settings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local World={} World.__index=World
function World.new(config,options)
 options=options or {}
 local studio=options.Studio if studio==nil then studio=RunService:IsStudio()end
 local self=setmetatable({Config=config,Settings=options.Settings or Settings,Studio=studio,
  PlaceId=options.PlaceId or game.PlaceId,JobId=options.JobId or game.JobId,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Mode="Connecting",Status="Connecting to the shared simulated exchange",Busy=false,Closing=false,
  Healthy=false,NextSave=0,NextAttempt=0,Epoch=0,Store=options.Store},World)
 self.Identity={Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),WorldId=Http:GenerateGUID(false),JobId=self.JobId,PlaceId=self.PlaceId}
 -- Private servers cannot be public teleport destinations. They only act as entry lobbies.
 self.CanOwn=options.CanOwn if self.CanOwn==nil then self.CanOwn=studio or game.PrivateServerId==""end
 return self
end
function World:_fresh()
 local seed=self.Studio and self.Settings.StudioReplaySeed or 0
 seed=seed or 0
 if seed==0 then seed=tonumber(Http:GenerateGUID(false):sub(1,8),16)%2147483646+1 end
 local engine=Engine.new(self.Config,seed) local population=Participants.new(engine)
 for i=1,math.floor(self.Config.WarmupSeconds/self.Config.StepSeconds)do
  population:Step() if i%200==0 then task.wait()end
 end
 return engine,population
end
function World:_encode()
 local record=Checkpoint.Encode(Checkpoint.Capture(self.Engine,self.Population))
 assert(#Http:JSONEncode(record)<self.Settings.MaxEncodedBytes,"Exchange checkpoint is too large; trading paused to protect saved state")
 return record,self.Engine.Step
end
function World:_sandbox(reason)
 self.Engine,self.Population=self:_fresh()
 self.Mode="Local" self.Status="LOCAL · NOT SAVED" self.Healthy=true self.Epoch+=1
 warn("[Get Funded!] Unsaved Studio sandbox: "..reason.." Publish a test experience and enable Studio API access for restart continuity.")
end
function World:Open()
 if self.Closing or self.Busy then return end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  if not self.Settings.Enabled or self.PlaceId==0 then
   assert(self.Studio and self.Settings.AllowUnsavedStudio,"Persistent storage is required for the live exchange")
   self:_sandbox(self.PlaceId==0 and "This place is unpublished." or "Persistence is disabled.") return
  end
  if not self.Store then
   self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore(self.Settings.StoreName,self.Studio and "Studio" or "Live")
  end
  self.Lease=self.Lease or Lease.new(self.Store,self.Settings,self.Identity,self.Now)
  local owned,record
  if self.CanOwn then owned,record=self.Lease:Claim()
  else owned=false record=self.Store:GetAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey)end
  if not owned then
   self.Owner=record self.Mode="Following" self.Healthy=false
   self.Status=self.Studio and "Shared Studio exchange is active in another test; stop it before restarting here" or "Joining the shared simulated exchange"
   return
  end
  self.Mode="Loading" self.Status="Restoring the saved simulated exchange"
  if record.Checkpoint then
   self.Engine,self.Population=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(record.Checkpoint),self.Config)
   assert(self.Engine.Step==record.SavedStep,"Checkpoint step does not match ownership record")
  else
   assert(record.SavedStep==0,"Saved exchange checkpoint is missing")
   self.Engine,self.Population=self:_fresh()
  end
  -- No client trades until the initial/loaded state has a confirmed durable checkpoint.
  local encoded,step=self:_encode()
  self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,false)
  self.Mode="Shared" self.Status="SHARED · SAVED" self.Healthy=true self.Epoch+=1
  self.NextSave=self.Now()+self.Settings.SaveSeconds
 end)
 self.Busy=false self.NextAttempt=self.Now()+self.Settings.RetrySeconds
 if not ok then
  -- Transient storage failures or corrupt checkpoints must never silently reset an existing market.
  self.Healthy=false self.Mode="Unavailable" self.Status="Saved exchange unavailable · retrying safely"
  self.LastError=tostring(err) warn("[Get Funded!] "..self.LastError)
 end
end
function World:CanRun()
 if self.Closing or not self.Healthy or not self.Engine then return false end
 return self.Mode=="Local" or (self.Mode=="Shared" and self.Lease:Valid())
end
function World:Label()
 if self.Mode=="Shared" and not self:CanRun()then return "PAUSED · WAITING FOR SAVED EXCHANGE"end
 return self.Status
end
function World:Save(release)
 if self.Busy or not self.Engine or self.Mode~="Shared" then return false end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local encoded,step=self:_encode()
  self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,release)
 end)
 self.Busy=false self.NextSave=self.Now()+(ok and self.Settings.SaveSeconds or self.Settings.RetrySeconds)
 self.Healthy=ok and not release
 if not ok then self.LastError=tostring(err) warn("[Get Funded!] Save failed; exchange paused: "..self.LastError)end
 return ok
end
function World:Maintain()
 if self.Closing or self.Busy or self.Mode=="Local"then return end
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Mode=="Shared"then
  if not self.Lease.Owned or now>=self.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil then
   -- Discard unsaved state after loss of authority. Reacquire and restore the durable record.
   self.Healthy=false self.Mode="Unavailable" self.Status="Reconnecting to the saved exchange"
   self.Engine=nil self.Population=nil self.Epoch+=1 self.NextAttempt=now
  elseif now>=self.NextSave then self:Save(false) return end
 end
 if self.Mode~="Shared" and now>=self.NextAttempt then self:Open()end
end
function World:Close()
 self.Closing=true
 -- A save already in flight finishes before the final frozen checkpoint and lease release.
 local deadline=os.clock()+24
 while self.Busy and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05)end
 if not self.Busy and self.Mode=="Shared" and self.Lease.Owned then
  repeat
   if self:Save(true)then return true end
   if not self.Lease.Owned or self.Now()>=self.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil then break end
   task.wait(1)
  until os.clock()>=deadline
 end
 return self.Mode=="Local"
end
return World

MarketEngine.Source:
-- Deterministic, server-only price/time priority exchange. Prices are integer ticks internally.
local Engine = {}
Engine.__index = Engine
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e12 end
local function integer(n) return finite(n) and n%1==0 end
local function sortedKeys(t)
 local keys={} for k in pairs(t) do table.insert(keys,k) end table.sort(keys) return keys
end
local function copy(t) local r={} for k,v in pairs(t) do r[k]=v end return r end
function Engine.new(config, seed)
 local self=setmetatable({Config=config,Seed=seed,Time=0,Step=0,Books={},Accounts={},AccountOrder={},Orders={},OrderArchive={},
  NextOrder=0,NextTrade=0,Trades={},PendingStops={},TotalVolume=0,TradeHash=0},Engine)
 for _,key in ipairs(config.ContractOrder) do
  local c=config.Contracts[key]
  local candles={} for _,tf in ipairs(config.Timeframes) do candles[tf[1]]={} end
  self.Books[key]={Key=key,Spec=c,Bids={},Asks={},Last=nil,Open=nil,Reference=math.round(c.Last/c.Tick),Volume=0,
   Candles=candles,CandleVolume={},Recent={},Up=0,Down=0,Volatility=1}
 end
 return self
end
function Engine:AddAccount(id,base,limit,risk,isPlayer)
 if self.Accounts[id] then return self.Accounts[id] end
 local a={Id=id,Base=base,Balance=base,Realized=0,CashFlow=0,Positions={},OpenOrders={},History={},Fills={},
  Limit=limit,Risk=risk,Player=isPlayer==true,Revision=0,Locked=false}
 self.Accounts[id]=a table.insert(self.AccountOrder,id) return a
end
function Engine:Summary(a)
 local unrealized,count,margin=0,0,0
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local b=self.Books[key] local p=a.Positions[key]
  if p then
   unrealized+=((b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick-p.Entry)*p.Quantity*p.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier
   count+=1 margin+=p.Quantity*b.Spec.Margin
  end
 end
 -- Funded accounts carry their own tier loss limit; older accounts keep the shared default.
 return {Balance=a.Balance,Equity=a.Balance+unrealized,Unrealized=unrealized,Session=a.Balance+unrealized-a.Base,
  Allowance=math.max(0,a.Balance+unrealized-a.Base+(a.LossLimit or self.Config.DailyLossLimit)),Count=count,Margin=margin}
end
function Engine:Exposure(a,key,side,qty)
 local used=0
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol] local net=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
  local buy,sell=0,0
  for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.OpenOrders)) do
   local o=self.Orders[id]
   if o and o.Contract==symbol then if o.Direction==1 then buy+=o.Remaining else sell+=o.Remaining end end
  end
  if symbol==key then if side==1 then buy+=qty else sell+=qty end end
  local worst=math.max(math.abs(net+buy),math.abs(net-sell))
  if worst>a.Limit then return false end
  used+=worst*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Margin
 end
 return used<=math.max(0,self:Summary(a).Equity)*a.Risk
end
function Engine:_retire(o,status)
 o.Status=status self.Accounts[o.Owner].OpenOrders[o.Id]=nil
 self.Orders[o.Id]=nil
 table.insert(self.OrderArchive,o)
 if #self.OrderArchive>self.Config.MaxOrderHistory then table.remove(self.OrderArchive,1) end
end
function Engine:Cancel(owner,id)
 local o=self.Orders[id]
 if not o or o.Owner~=owner then return false,"Order is no longer working." end
 o.Cancelled+=o.Remaining o.Remaining=0 self:_retire(o,"Cancelled")
 self.Accounts[owner].Revision+=1
 self:_cleanBook(self.Books[o.Contract])
 return true,"Simulated order cancelled."
end
function Engine:CancelAll(owner,key)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner]
 for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.OpenOrders)) do
  local o=self.Orders[id] if o and (not key or o.Contract==key) then self:Cancel(owner,id) end
 end
end
function Engine:_cleanBook(b)
 for _,side in ipairs({b.Bids,b.Asks}) do
  for i=#side,1,-1 do
   local level=side[i] local quantity=0
   for j=#level.Orders,1,-1 do
    local o=level.Orders[j]
    if o.Remaining<=0 then table.remove(level.Orders,j) else quantity+=o.Remaining end
   end
   level.Quantity=quantity if quantity==0 then table.remove(side,i) end
  end
 end
end
function Engine:_rest(b,o)
 local levels=o.Direction==1 and b.Bids or b.Asks
 local at=#levels+1
 for i,l in ipairs(levels) do
  if l.Price==o.Price then table.insert(l.Orders,o) l.Quantity+=o.Remaining return end
  if (o.Price-l.Price)*o.Direction>0 then at=i break end
 end
 table.insert(levels,at,{Price=o.Price,Quantity=o.Remaining,Orders={o}})
end
function Engine:_fillAccount(o,price,qty,tradeId)
 local a=self.Accounts[o.Owner] local b=self.Books[o.Contract] local p=a.Positions[o.Contract]
 local side=o.Direction local oldNet=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0 local delta=side*qty
 a.CashFlow-=price*delta*b.Spec.Multiplier -- double-entry notional audit ledger; not spendable futures cash
 local realized=0
 if p and oldNet*delta<0 then
  local closed=math.min(math.abs(oldNet),qty)
  realized=(price-p.Entry)*closed*p.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier
  a.Balance+=realized a.Realized+=realized
  table.insert(a.History,1,{Contract=o.Contract,Direction=p.Direction,Quantity=closed,Entry=p.Entry,Exit=price,Pnl=realized,
   Time=string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d",math.floor(self.Time/3600)%24,math.floor(self.Time/60)%60,math.floor(self.Time)%60),TradeId=tradeId})
  if #a.History>self.Config.MaxAccountHistory then table.remove(a.History) end
 end
 local net=oldNet+delta
 if net==0 then a.Positions[o.Contract]=nil
 elseif not p or oldNet*net<0 then
  p={Id=o.Id,Contract=o.Contract,Direction=net>0 and 1 or -1,Quantity=math.abs(net),Entry=price}
  a.Positions[o.Contract]=p
 else
  if oldNet*delta>0 then p.Entry=(p.Entry*math.abs(oldNet)+price*qty)/math.abs(net) end
  p.Quantity=math.abs(net)
 end
 p=a.Positions[o.Contract]
 if p and not o.ReduceOnly and p.Direction==side then
  if o.StopTicks then p.Stop=math.round((p.Entry-side*o.StopTicks*b.Spec.Tick)/b.Spec.Tick)*b.Spec.Tick end
  if o.TargetTicks then p.Target=math.round((p.Entry+side*o.TargetTicks*b.Spec.Tick)/b.Spec.Tick)*b.Spec.Tick end
 end
 o.Remaining-=qty o.Filled+=qty o.Notional+=price*qty
 a.Revision+=1
 if a.Player then
  table.insert(a.Fills,1,{TradeId=tradeId,OrderId=o.Id,Contract=o.Contract,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Price=price,
   Slippage=(price-o.Reference*b.Spec.Tick)*side,Time=self.Time})
  if #a.Fills>40 then table.remove(a.Fills) end
 end
end
function Engine:_trade(b,incoming,resting,qty)
 local tick=resting.Price local price=tick*b.Spec.Tick
 self.NextTrade+=1
 local trade={Id=self.NextTrade,Time=self.Time,Step=self.Step,Contract=b.Key,Price=price,Ticks=tick,Quantity=qty,
  Buyer=incoming.Direction==1 and incoming.Owner or resting.Owner,Seller=incoming.Direction==-1 and incoming.Owner or resting.Owner}
 self:_fillAccount(incoming,price,qty,trade.Id) self:_fillAccount(resting,price,qty,trade.Id)
 local prior=b.Last
 if prior then
  if tick>prior then b.Up+=1 elseif tick<prior then b.Down+=1 end
  b.Volatility=b.Volatility*0.96+math.abs(tick-prior)*0.04
 end
 -- Sole writer of last price. Quotes, regimes and news never set this field.
 b.Last=tick b.Open=b.Open or tick b.Volume+=qty self.TotalVolume+=qty
 table.insert(b.Recent,tick) if #b.Recent>64 then table.remove(b.Recent,1) end
 table.insert(self.Trades,trade) if #self.Trades>self.Config.MaxTradeHistory then table.remove(self.Trades,1) end
 self.TradeHash=(self.TradeHash*31+tick*7+qty*13+trade.Id+self.Step)%2147483647
 for _,tf in ipairs(self.Config.Timeframes) do
  local series=b.Candles[tf[1]] local bucket=math.floor(self.Time/tf[2])*tf[2] local candle=series[#series]
  if not candle or candle.Time~=bucket then
   candle={Time=bucket,Open=price,High=price,Low=price,Close=price,Volume=0}
   table.insert(series,candle) if #series>self.Config.MaxCandles then table.remove(series,1) end
  end
  candle.High=math.max(candle.High,price) candle.Low=math.min(candle.Low,price) candle.Close=price candle.Volume+=qty
  b.CandleVolume[tf[1]]=(b.CandleVolume[tf[1]] or 0)+qty
 end
 -- Latch on each execution so an intrastep crossing cannot be missed.
 for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder) do
  local p=self.Accounts[id].Positions[b.Key]
  if p and not p.Triggered then
   local reason
   if p.Stop and (price-p.Stop)*p.Direction<=0 then reason="Stop loss"
   elseif p.Target and (price-p.Target)*p.Direction>=0 then reason="Take profit" end
   if reason then
    p.Triggered=reason
    if reason=="Stop loss" then p.Target=nil else p.Stop=nil end
    table.insert(self.PendingStops,{Owner=id,Contract=b.Key,Position=p.Id})
   end
  end
 end
end
function Engine:Submit(owner,request)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner]
 if not a or type(request)~="table" then return false,"Unknown account." end
 local b=self.Books[request.Contract]
 local side,qty,kind=request.Direction,request.Quantity,request.Type
 if not b or (side~=1 and side~=-1) or not integer(qty) or qty<1 or qty>(a.Player and self.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity or 10000) then return false,"Invalid instrument, side or quantity." end
 if kind~="Market" and kind~="Limit" then return false,"Use Market or Limit." end
 local p=a.Positions[b.Key]
 local reducing=request.ReduceOnly==true
 if reducing and (not p or p.Direction==side or qty>p.Quantity) then return false,"No matching position to reduce." end
 if a.Locked and not reducing then return false,"Simulated risk limit reached. Close positions only." end
 local price=request.Price
 if kind=="Limit" then
  if not finite(price) or price<=0 or math.abs(price/b.Spec.Tick-math.round(price/b.Spec.Tick))>0.00001 then return false,"Limit price must use the instrument tick size." end
  price=math.round(price/b.Spec.Tick)
  if math.abs(price-(b.Last or b.Reference))>(b.Last or b.Reference)*self.Config.PriceBandFraction then return false,"Limit is outside the simulated price band." end
 end
 for _,field in ipairs({"StopTicks","TargetTicks"}) do
  local v=request[field] if v~=nil and (not integer(v) or v<1 or v>10000) then return false,"Protection must use 1–10,000 whole ticks." end
 end
 if a.Player then
  local n=0 for _ in pairs(a.OpenOrders) do n+=1 end
  if n>=self.Config.MaxPlayerOrders and not reducing then return false,"Too many working orders." end
  if not reducing and self:Summary(a).Allowance<=0 then return false,"Daily simulated loss allowance exhausted." end
  if not reducing and request.StopTicks and request.StopTicks*b.Spec.Tick*b.Spec.Multiplier*qty>self:Summary(a).Allowance then return false,"Order exceeds your simulated loss allowance." end
 end
 if not reducing and not self:Exposure(a,b.Key,side,qty) then return false,"Insufficient simulated margin or inventory capacity." end
 self:_cleanBook(b)
 local opposing=side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids
 self.NextOrder+=1
 local o={Id=self.NextOrder,Owner=owner,Contract=b.Key,Direction=side,Original=qty,Remaining=qty,Filled=0,Cancelled=0,Notional=0,
  Price=price,Type=kind,Status="Working",Time=self.Time,Reference=opposing[1] and opposing[1].Price or b.Last or b.Reference,
  StopTicks=request.StopTicks,TargetTicks=request.TargetTicks,ReduceOnly=reducing,Expires=request.Expires,
  Link=integer(request.Link) and request.Link or nil} -- server-set lead order id for copied orders
 self.Orders[o.Id]=o a.OpenOrders[o.Id]=true
 for _,level in ipairs(opposing) do
  if o.Remaining<=0 then break end
  if kind=="Limit" and (level.Price-price)*side>0 then break end
  for _,resting in ipairs(level.Orders) do
   if o.Remaining<=0 then break end
   if resting.Remaining>0 then
    local restingAccount=self.Accounts[resting.Owner]
    if resting.Owner==owner or (a.Group~=nil and restingAccount.Group==a.Group) then
     -- Cancel the older self quote. A self-trade must never manufacture volume, including between
     -- two accounts owned by the same player.
     resting.Cancelled+=resting.Remaining resting.Remaining=0 self:_retire(resting,"Self-trade prevented")
     if resting.Owner~=owner then restingAccount.Revision+=1 end
    else
     local rp=restingAccount.Positions[b.Key]
     local available=resting.Remaining
     if resting.ReduceOnly then available=(rp and rp.Direction~=resting.Direction) and math.min(available,rp.Quantity) or 0 end
     if available<=0 then resting.Cancelled+=resting.Remaining resting.Remaining=0 self:_retire(resting,"Cancelled")
     else
      self:_trade(b,o,resting,math.min(o.Remaining,available))
      if resting.Remaining==0 then self:_retire(resting,"Filled") end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if o.Remaining==0 then self:_retire(o,"Filled")
 elseif kind=="Market" then o.Cancelled+=o.Remaining o.Remaining=0 self:_retire(o,o.Filled>0 and "Partial / IOC" or "No liquidity")
 else self:_rest(b,o) end
 self:_cleanBook(b) a.Revision+=1
 local average=o.Filled>0 and o.Notional/o.Filled or nil
 return true,{Id=o.Id,Filled=o.Filled,Remaining=o.Remaining,Cancelled=o.Cancelled,Average=average,Status=o.Status,
  Slippage=average and (average-o.Reference*b.Spec.Tick)*side or 0}
end
function Engine:ProcessStops()
 -- Bounded queue also handles cascades; deferred tails continue next scheduler step.
 local processed=0
 while #self.PendingStops>0 and processed<200 do
  local item=table.remove(self.PendingStops,1) local a=self.Accounts[item.Owner] local p=a.Positions[item.Contract]
  processed+=1
  if p and p.Id==item.Position and p.Triggered then
   self:CancelAll(a.Id,item.Contract)
   self:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=item.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=math.min(p.Quantity,a.Player and self.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity or 10000),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
  end
 end
end
function Engine:AdvanceClock(dt)
 self.Time+=dt self.Step+=1
 for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(self.Orders)) do
  local o=self.Orders[id] if o.Expires and o.Expires<=self.Time then self:Cancel(o.Owner,id) end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder) do
  local a=self.Accounts[id] local summary=self:Summary(a)
  if summary.Equity<=0 or summary.Margin>math.max(0,summary.Equity)*1.05 or (a.Player and summary.Allowance<=0) then
   a.Locked=true self:CancelAll(id)
   for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do local p=a.Positions[key] if p then p.Triggered="Risk liquidation" p.Stop=nil p.Target=nil end end
  end
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local p=a.Positions[key] if p and p.Triggered then table.insert(self.PendingStops,{Owner=id,Contract=key,Position=p.Id}) end
  end
 end
 self:ProcessStops()
end
function Engine:AmendProtection(owner,request)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner]
 if not a or type(request)~="table" then return false,"Unknown account." end
 local field=request.Protection
 if field~="Stop" and field~="Target" then return false,"Invalid protection." end
 local b=self.Books[request.Contract] local p=a.Positions[request.Contract]
 if not b or not p or p.Id~=request.OrderId or p.Triggered or not p[field] or a.Locked then
  return false,"Protection already triggered, cancelled or position closed."
 end
 if not finite(request.ExpectedPrice) or math.abs(request.ExpectedPrice-p[field])>b.Spec.Tick*0.00001 then
  return false,"Protection changed while dragging. Please try again."
 end
 local price=request.Price local tick=b.Spec.Tick
 if not finite(price) or price<=0 or math.abs(price/tick-math.round(price/tick))>0.00001 then
  return false,"Protection price must use the instrument tick size."
 end
 price=math.round(price/tick)*tick
 local last=(b.Last or b.Reference)*tick
 if math.abs(price-last)>last*self.Config.PriceBandFraction then return false,"Protection is outside the simulated price band." end
 local distance=(price-last)*p.Direction
 if (field=="Stop" and distance>=0) or (field=="Target" and distance<=0) then
  return false,field=="Stop" and "Keep SL beyond the current price on the loss side." or "Keep TP beyond the current price on the profit side."
 end
 -- Account allowance is marked to the last execution; allow stops that lock in a profit.
 if field=="Stop" and a.Player and -distance*p.Quantity*b.Spec.Multiplier>self:Summary(a).Allowance then
  return false,"Stop exceeds your remaining simulated loss allowance."
 end
 p[field]=price a.Revision+=1
 return true,string.format("Simulated %s moved to %.2f.",field=="Stop" and "SL" or "TP",price)
end
function Engine:CancelProtection(owner,id,field)
 if field~="Stop" and field~="Target" then return false,"Invalid protection." end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=self.Accounts[owner].Positions[key]
  if p and p.Id==id and not p.Triggered then p[field]=nil self.Accounts[owner].Revision+=1 return true,"Protection cancelled." end
 end
 return false,"Protection already triggered or position closed."
end
function Engine:Snapshot(owner,key,timeframe,full)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner] local positions,orders={},{}
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol]
  if p then
   positions[symbol]=copy(p)
   positions[symbol].Unrealized=((self.Books[symbol].Last or self.Books[symbol].Reference)*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Tick-p.Entry)*p.Quantity*p.Direction*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Multiplier
   for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"}) do if p[field] then table.insert(orders,{Id=p.Id,Contract=symbol,Quantity=p.Quantity,
    Kind=field=="Stop" and "Stop loss" or "Take profit",Price=p[field],Protection=field,Status=p.Triggered or "Armed"}) end end
  end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.OpenOrders)) do
  local o=self.Orders[id] if o then table.insert(orders,{Id=id,Contract=o.Contract,Quantity=o.Remaining,Original=o.Original,Filled=o.Filled,
   Kind=o.Direction==1 and "Buy limit" or "Sell limit",Price=o.Price*self.Books[o.Contract].Spec.Tick,Status=o.Filled>0 and "Partial" or "Working"}) end
 end
 local quotes={}
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local b=self.Books[symbol] local tick=b.Spec.Tick
  local bid=b.Bids[1] and b.Bids[1].Price*tick local ask=b.Asks[1] and b.Asks[1].Price*tick
  quotes[symbol]={Last=b.Last and b.Last*tick,Open=b.Open and b.Open*tick,Bid=bid,Ask=ask,Spread=bid and ask and ask-bid,
   Volume=b.Volume,TradeCount=b.Up+b.Down,Recent={},Depth={Bids={},Asks={}}}
  for i=math.max(1,#b.Recent-15),#b.Recent do table.insert(quotes[symbol].Recent,b.Recent[i]*tick) end
  for _,side in ipairs({"Bids","Asks"}) do for i=1,math.min(5,#b[side]) do local l=b[side][i] table.insert(quotes[symbol].Depth[side],{Price=l.Price*tick,Quantity=l.Quantity}) end end
 end
 local series=self.Books[key].Candles[timeframe] local candles={}
 for i=full and 1 or math.max(1,#series-1),#series do table.insert(candles,copy(series[i])) end
 return {Seed=self.Seed,Time=self.Time,Step=self.Step,Quotes=quotes,Positions=positions,Orders=orders,History=a.History,Fills=a.Fills,
  Base=a.Base,Summary=self:Summary(a),Contract=key,Timeframe=timeframe,Candles=candles,Full=full,Revision=a.Revision,Locked=a.Locked}
end
function Engine:Audit()
 local cash,equity,inventory,volume=0,0,{},0
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do inventory[key]=0 end
 for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder) do
  local a=self.Accounts[id] cash+=a.CashFlow equity+=self:Summary(a).Equity-a.Base
  assert(math.abs(a.Balance-a.Base-a.Realized)<0.001,"Balance / realized reconciliation")
  for key,p in pairs(a.Positions) do inventory[key]+=p.Quantity*p.Direction end
 end
 assert(math.abs(cash)<0.01,"Notional cash is not conserved") assert(math.abs(equity)<0.01,"Total marked P&L is not zero")
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  assert(inventory[key]==0,"Inventory is not conserved") local b=self.Books[key] volume+=b.Volume
  for _,tf in ipairs(self.Config.Timeframes) do assert((b.CandleVolume[tf[1]] or 0)==b.Volume,"Candle volume mismatch") end
  for _,side in ipairs({b.Bids,b.Asks}) do
   for _,l in ipairs(side) do local total=0 local arrival=0 for _,o in ipairs(l.Orders) do
    assert(o.Remaining>0 and self.Orders[o.Id]==o,"Stale resting order") assert(o.Id>arrival,"FIFO violated") arrival=o.Id total+=o.Remaining
   end assert(total==l.Quantity,"Level quantity mismatch") end
  end
  assert(not b.Bids[1] or not b.Asks[1] or b.Bids[1].Price<b.Asks[1].Price,"Crossed resting book")
 end
 for _,list in ipairs({self.Orders,self.OrderArchive}) do for _,o in pairs(list) do assert(o.Original==o.Filled+o.Remaining+o.Cancelled,"Order quantity mismatch") end end
 assert(volume==self.TotalVolume,"Total volume mismatch")
 return {CashError=cash,EquityError=equity,Inventory=inventory,Volume=volume,Trades=self.NextTrade,Hash=self.TradeHash}
end
return Engine

-- One deterministic scheduler; participants never own task loops or modify trade prices.
local Participants={}
Participants.__index=Participants
local RNG={} RNG.__index=RNG
function RNG.new(seed) return setmetatable({State=math.floor(math.abs(seed))%2147483646+1},RNG) end
function RNG:Next() self.State=self.State*48271%2147483647 return self.State/2147483647 end
function RNG:Range(a,b) return a+(b-a)*self:Next() end
function RNG:Int(a,b) return math.floor(self:Range(a,b+1)) end
function RNG:Noise() return (self:Next()+self:Next()+self:Next()-1.5)*2 end
Participants.RNG=RNG
function Participants.new(engine)
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=engine.Config,Random=RNG.new(engine.Seed),Agents={},Markets={},Regime=nil,
  NextRegime=0,NextNews=80,NextBeliefs=0,News="No synthetic news",NewsUntil=0,Events={}},Participants)
 local r=self.Random
 self:_regime()
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local book=engine.Books[key]
  self.Markets[key]={Fair=book.Reference,Anchor=book.Reference,Impulse=0}
  for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
  for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
   local total=0 for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 end
   local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen="Liquidity"
   for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 if draw<=0 then chosen=kind break end end
   self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
  end
  if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 end
 -- A genuine opening auction: finite makers post, and a participant crosses a quote.
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Key==key and a.Kind~="Maker" then
   engine:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break
  end end
 end
 return self
end
function Participants:_agent(key,kind,index)
 local r=self.Random local maker=kind=="Maker" local whale=kind=="Whale"
 local id="bot:"..key..":"..kind..":"..index
 local budget=r:Int(maker and 350000 or whale and 600000 or 50000,maker and 650000 or whale and 1100000 or 160000)
 local a={Id=id,Key=key,Kind=kind,Budget=budget,Risk=r:Range(0.45,0.85),Limit=r:Int(maker and 140 or whale and 180 or 16,maker and 250 or whale and 350 or 60),
  Speed=r:Range(maker and 1.5 or whale and 28 or 2.5,maker and 4.5 or whale and 100 or 13),Size=r:Int(maker and 3 or whale and 18 or 1,maker and 9 or whale and 60 or 5),
  Bias=r:Range(-0.55,0.55),Belief=self.Markets[key].Fair+r:Noise()*9,Patience=r:Range(4,35),Aggression=r:Range(0.2,0.8),
  Next=r:Range(0.2,18),Stop=r:Int(16,85),Target=r:Int(20,140),Parent=0,ParentSide=1}
 if whale then a.Bias=index%2==0 and -0.3 or 0.3 end
 self.Engine:AddAccount(id,budget,a.Limit,a.Risk,false) table.insert(self.Agents,a)
end
function Participants:_regime()
 local r=self.Random local total=0 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do total+=regime.Weight end
 local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen=self.Config.Regimes[1]
 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do draw-=regime.Weight if draw<=0 then chosen=regime break end end
 self.Regime=chosen self.Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
 self.NextRegime=self.Engine.Time+r:Range(self.Config.RegimeSeconds[1],self.Config.RegimeSeconds[2])
 table.insert(self.Events,{Step=self.Engine.Step,Kind="Regime",Name=chosen.Name,Direction=self.Direction})
 if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
end
function Participants:_maker(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key)
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local stress=self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility+math.min(6,b.Volatility)*0.2
 local center=(b.Last or b.Reference)*0.83+market.Fair*0.17-inventory/a.Limit*(5+stress*5)+r:Noise()*0.7
 local spread=math.max(1,math.floor(stress*0.8+b.Volatility*0.2+r:Range(0,1.4)))
 local liquidity=self.Regime.Liquidity*self.Config.Liquidity
 if self.Engine.Time<self.NewsUntil then liquidity*=0.6 end
 if r:Next()>math.min(1,liquidity*1.7) then return end
 for depth=1,3 do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1}) do
   local size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*liquidity*r:Range(0.55,1.25)*(1-inventory/a.Limit*side*0.8)))
   local tick=math.max(1,math.round(center-side*(spread+(depth-1)*math.max(1,math.floor(stress)))))
   e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",Price=tick*c.Tick,Expires=e.Time+a.Speed*2.8})
  end
 end
end
function Participants:_trader(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 if r:Next()<0.25 then return end -- varied inactivity, even around news
 local last=b.Last or b.Reference local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 a.Belief+=(market.Fair-a.Belief)*r:Range(0.02,0.18)+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*c.Scale*0.6
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local recent=b.Recent local previous=recent[math.max(1,#recent-r:Int(8,35))] or last
 local momentum=(last-previous)/math.max(3,b.Volatility*8)
 local edge=(a.Belief-last)/math.max(4,b.Volatility*8)
 local signal=a.Bias+r:Noise()*1.3-inventory/a.Limit*1.8
 if a.Kind=="Momentum" then signal+=momentum*r:Range(0.5,1.4)
 elseif a.Kind=="Value" then signal+=edge*r:Range(0.6,1.5)
 elseif a.Kind=="Reversion" then signal-=momentum*r:Range(0.6,1.6) signal+=edge*0.3
 elseif a.Kind=="Protective" then signal+=edge*0.4 end
 if math.abs(signal)<r:Range(0.1,0.55) then return end
 local side=signal>0 and 1 or -1 local size=r:Int(1,a.Size)
 local aggressive=r:Next()<a.Aggression
 if a.Kind=="Whale" then
  if a.Parent>0 then side=a.ParentSide size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,math.max(5,math.floor(a.Size/3)))) a.Parent-=size
  else
   size=r:Int(math.floor(a.Size/2),a.Size)
   if r:Next()<0.55 then a.Parent=size*r:Int(2,4) a.ParentSide=side size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,12)) a.Parent-=size end
  end
  aggressive=r:Next()<0.8
 end
 if r:Next()<0.45 then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key) end
 local request={Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type=aggressive and "Market" or "Limit",Expires=e.Time+a.Patience*r:Range(0.5,1.5)}
 if not aggressive then
  local distance=r:Int(1,math.max(2,math.floor(3+self.Regime.Volatility*3)))
  request.Price=math.max(1,math.round(last-side*distance))*c.Tick
 end
 if a.Kind=="Protective" or (a.Kind~="Maker" and r:Next()<0.16) then request.StopTicks=a.Stop request.TargetTicks=a.Target end
 e:Submit(a.Id,request)
end
function Participants:Step()
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random
 e:AdvanceClock(self.Config.StepSeconds)
 if e.Time>=self.NextRegime then self:_regime() end
 if self.Config.NewsFrequency>0 and e.Time>=self.NextNews then
  local sign=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
  local magnitude=r:Range(8,40)*self.Config.Volatility
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local shock=sign*magnitude*e.Books[key].Spec.Scale*r:Range(0.4,1.5)
   m.Anchor+=shock m.Impulse+=shock*0.1
  end
  self.News=(sign>0 and "Optimistic" or "Cautious").." synthetic outlook"
  self.NewsUntil=e.Time+r:Range(20,55) self.NextNews=e.Time+r:Range(140,420)/self.Config.NewsFrequency
  table.insert(self.Events,{Step=e.Step,Kind="News",Name=self.News,Direction=sign}) if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
 end
 if e.Time>=self.NextBeliefs then
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local c=e.Books[key].Spec
   m.Anchor+=self.Regime.Trend*self.Direction*c.Scale+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility*c.Scale*0.16
   m.Fair+=(m.Anchor-m.Fair)*0.025+m.Impulse*0.06
   m.Impulse*=0.96
   m.Fair=math.clamp(m.Fair,e.Books[key].Reference*0.6,e.Books[key].Reference*1.4)
  end
  self.NextBeliefs=e.Time+1
 end
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do
  if e.Time>=a.Next then
   if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) else self:_trader(a) end
   local delay=a.Speed*r:Range(0.45,1.65)/self.Regime.Activity

 -- Effects queued by replies run after the rebuild they trigger, on the rebuilt controls.
 local queuedEffects={}
 local function locate(path)
  local node=canvas
  for part in path:gmatch("[^%.]+")do node=node and node:FindFirstChild(part)end
  return node
 end
 local function runEffects()
  if not fx or #queuedEffects==0 then return end
  local list=queuedEffects;queuedEffects={}
  for _,e in ipairs(list)do
   local target;for _,path in ipairs(e.Paths)do target=target or locate(path)end
   if target then
    if e.Kind=="Success"then fx:Pulse(target);fx:Ring(target,e.Color or C.Green,14)
    elseif e.Kind=="Error"then fx:Shake(target)
    elseif e.Kind=="Pulse"then fx:Pulse(target)end
   end
  end
 end
 local function effect(paths,kind,color)
  if not fx then return end
  table.insert(queuedEffects,{Paths=paths,Kind=kind,Color=color})
  task.delay(.08,runEffects) -- in case no rebuild follows
 end

  if not pf.FirstProfit then
   return "FIRST MILESTONE","Close a trade in profit",0,"Net "..net(pf.Earned),"First milestone: close a trade in profit"
  end
  if not pf.Next then return "LADDER COMPLETE","Every account unlocked",1,"Net "..net(pf.Earned),"Ladder complete · net "..net(pf.Earned)end

  if (s.StopOn and(s.StopTicks<1 or s.StopTicks%1~=0))or(s.TargetOn and(s.TargetTicks<1 or s.TargetTicks%1~=0))then
   fail("Protection distances must be positive whole ticks.");effect(paths,"Error");return

 local function chart(x,y,w,h,mobile,compact,short,updating)
  local ok,err=xpcall(chartView.Paint,debug.traceback,chartView,x,y,w,h,mobile,compact,updating)
  if ok then
   if chartFault then chartFault=nil;root:SetAttribute("ChartError",nil)end
   return
  end
  painting=nil;chartView:Reset()
  local message=tostring(err)
  if message~=chartFault or os.clock()-faultAt>10 then warn("[Get Funded!] Chart paint failed; recovering: "..message)end
  chartFault=message;faultAt=os.clock();root:SetAttribute("ChartError",message:sub(1,200))

  task.delay(updating and 1 or 0,function()if alive then fullRefreshPending=false;refresh()end end)

 local function numericStepper(p,name,x,y,w,value,step,minimum,maximum,setter,formatter,enabled)
  local height=44;local bw=math.min(44,math.floor((w-32)/2))
  local shell=frame(p,name,x,y,w,height,C.Bg,p.ZIndex);round(shell,10);stroke(shell,Color3.fromRGB(26,99,212)).Thickness=2
  local current=value
  local field=make("TextBox","Value",shell,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(bw,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w-bw*2,height),BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Text=formatter and formatter(value)or tostring(value),TextColor3=enabled==false and C.Muted or C.Text,Font=B,TextSize=24,TextScaled=true,TextStrokeColor3=SC.Ink,TextStrokeTransparency=.55,
   ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextEditable=enabled~=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=shell.ZIndex+1})
  make("UITextSizeConstraint","TextSize",field,{MinTextSize=10,MaxTextSize=24})
  local function display(n)return formatter and formatter(n)or tostring(n)end

   if enabled==false then return true end

   if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge or n<minimum or n>maximum or(step==1 and n%1~=0)then

    field.Text=display(current);fail(s.Error);if fx then fx:Shake(shell)end;return false
   end
   n=math.clamp(math.round(n/step)*step,minimum,maximum)
   current=n;field.Text=display(n);setter(n);s.Error=nil;return true
  end

   local control=gameControl(button(shell,d[1],d[2],d[4],0,bw,height,function()
    if enabled==false or not commit()then return end

-- Funded-account ladder. Shared with clients for display only; MarketServer enforces every rule.
-- Change tiers here. Keep Size and Unlock ascending, and keep Unlock = 0 only for the starter tier.
-- Unlock values are lifetime NET REALIZED profit across the player's funded accounts (closed trades only).
-- Starting balances, open P&L and legacy practice accounts never count toward unlocks.
return {
 StarterTier="F5K",
 Tiers={
  {Id="F5K", Short="$5K", Name="$5K Funded", Size=5000, Unlock=0, LossLimit=500, MaxContracts=5},
  {Id="F10K", Short="$10K", Name="$10K Funded", Size=10000, Unlock=300, LossLimit=800, MaxContracts=10},
  {Id="F25K", Short="$25K", Name="$25K Funded", Size=25000, Unlock=1500, LossLimit=1500, MaxContracts=20},
  {Id="F50K", Short="$50K", Name="$50K Funded", Size=50000, Unlock=4000, LossLimit=2500, MaxContracts=30},
  {Id="F100K", Short="$100K", Name="$100K Funded", Size=100000, Unlock=10000, LossLimit=4000, MaxContracts=40},
 },
 -- Fraction of equity each funded account may commit as simulated margin.
 MarginUse=0.8,
 -- A breached account (loss allowance used up) can restart with fresh capital. Its realized loss stays
 -- in the lifetime net-profit total, so restarting never erases progress requirements.
 AllowRestart=true,
 -- Practice accounts created before the funded ladder existed. Kept and tradable, never counted.
 LegacyBases={50000,100000},
 LegacyTradable=true,
 CopyTrading={
  MinAccounts=2, -- introduced after the player activates a second funded account
  DefaultSizing="Same", -- "Same" copies the lead quantity; "Proportional" scales by account size
 },
}
